title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE
html:
INSTITUTE OF ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE

Prof Dr Zulfiqar Ali Shah
Director, Institute of English Language and Literature

INTRODUCTION

The Institute of English Language and Literature originally the Department of English (1989) was upgraded in 2014 as an Institute offering degrees in Language, Linguistics and Literature. It is one of the oldest and top- rated departments of the University. Since its inception the department played an important role in teaching of English compulsory to 28 departments/institutes of the University and then establishing its own specialization degree programmes in Language, Linguistics & Literature. The Institute is offering BS (Four years) in English Linguistics and Literature; M.A of two years duration in Linguistics and Literature and M.Phil/MS in Linguistics and Literature. These degree programs meet national requirements and standards. With 23 members of academic staff, the Institute teaches across the whole range of English Studies from English literature to modern Linguistics.
We try to provide students with stimulating and challenging environment in which they can develop their competence and skills in all areas of English Linguistics and Literature. Thus, the overall objective of the Institute is to enable students to acquire an advanced conceptual knowledge and technical skills in Linguistics, Literary, Cultural, Communicative, Critical, Creative, and Humanistic competence broad enough to make them succeed in diverse walks of practical life quite effectively and efficiently.
We provide intensive monitoring to our students both in and outside of the classroom in a wide variety of forums. Lectures, workshops, conferences, trainings and debates make up our calendar. We take pride in the fact that students here are taught with great care & love.

VISION

To be a world class centre of excellence in English Linguistics and Literature based on Production, Contribution, and Achievement par excellence in the field of English through Teaching and Research; and based on uncompromising Quality, Credibility, Competence and Character.

MISSION


Our Mission is to educate, enable, and empower students to achieve excellence, wellbeing, and success in life by imparting in them conceptual knowledge and technical skills in English Language, Linguistics, and Literature as well as the development of their personality and character through education and training in 21st century skills of problem solving, communication skills, imagination, creativity, and critical thinking.

PROGRAMS OFFERED AIM AT:

  • Enabling individuals to face with success the challenges of modern times
  • Empowering students with critical thinking, analytical reasoning, communicative skills, emotional intelligence, 21st century skills of leadership and individual excellence
  • Encouraging the learners to read and analyze critically a wide range of texts to orientate the learners to various traditions of writing and speech in English
  • Equipping the graduates of the region to face the challenges of globalization posed by language, linguistics, culture and various modes of communication.
  • Providing a welcoming, supportive and familiar environment in which students will feel comfortable- whether they are learning English for pleasure or for preparation for their future career which means they are immersed in the kind of authentic language learning environment which is so vital to improving confidence and proficiency.
  • Displaying substantial proficiency in oral/speech and written in English
  • Demonstrating knowledge of the core linguistic and literary concepts and their various applications
  • Using critical concepts and terminology, both in Literature and Linguistics with understanding
  • Expressing the ability to respond to and interpret a range of text types effectively
  • Analyzing individual texts and make comparisons between them
  • Appreciating the significance of social and historical context in analyzing texts
  • Tracing and recognizing the major traditions in research on select issues/themes
  • Conducting a small-scale research study in an area of interest.
  • Enhancing their employability in various fields, such as media, communications, teaching, competitive examinations and other relevant fields.

RESEARCH ACTIVITIES
ELF ANNUAL RESEARCH JOURNAL

The ELF Annual Research Journal is published annually by the Institute of English Language and Literature. This journal is recognized by HEC in the year 2009 and since then it is fully funded by Higher Education Commission of Pakistan (HEC) for its publication. This falls in the ‘Y’ category of HEC recognized national journals. Total 21 volumes have been published so for. This is also indexed by the international database agencies such as MLA, Thomson Reuters, Linguistics Abstracts Online and Ulrich international.

PROGRAMS OFFERED
1. BS (Four-Year) in English (Linguistics) (Morning & Evening Program)
2. BS (Four-Year) in English (Literature) (Morning & Evening Program)
3. M.A (Two-Year) (Linguistics)
4. M.A (Two-Year) (Literature)
5. M.A (Two-Year) (Languages & Literature) (Evening Program)
6. M. Phil (Linguistics) (New intake is temporarily suspended)

INSTITUTE OF GENDER STUDIES

Dr. Agha Nadia Pathan Incharge

INTRODUCTION
The Institute of Gender Studies was established in 2013. The main objectives of the institute are to train the students and workers of this region in Gender Studies, to promote co-operation in inter-disciplinary relationship with others teaching/research departments and NGO establishment, and to arrange seminars and workshops in order to raise the awareness about gender and its implications. The institute offers multidisciplinary courses that explore the making and meaning of gender – femininity and masculinity across cultures and social formations.

VISION
Becoming a world-class institute in the field of gender studies and promoting the subject as a learning discipline in the remote areas.

MISSION

  • To enhance understanding of gender and how it is socially constructed
  • To create an awareness about gender in the context of South Asia in general and Pakistan in particular
  • To analyze critically the status of women in Pakistani society
  • To evaluate development approaches worldwide and their effects on women
  • To explore political and theoretical dimensions of feminist pedagogy

title: GEOGRAPHY
html:
DEPARTMENT OF GEOGRAPHY

Dr. Noor Hussain Chandio
Incharge Chairman

INTRODUCTION
The Department of Geography offers the Bachelor & Master’s level courses in the discipline of Geography. The discipline has been opened to meet the long standing demands of the people of upper Sindh. The classes of BS (4 year) Program started from the academic year 2005-06 and M.A/M.Sc from the Year 2010. Department of Geography announced the admissions in MS/M.Phil in Geography started from the academic year 2020.

The subject of Geography provides wealth of information and advanced knowledge of the Earth’s surface. It is meant to open further frontiers of knowledge for the students and to give an understanding and the preparation which may help them proceed further to acquire the present day knowledge of the concepts of Geographical Science.

The discipline of Geography deals with Physical Geography, Climatology, Hydrography, Geomorphology, Biogeography, the Geography of soils and Plants, Animals and Human Geography. Historically Geography is concerned primarily with the Human Geography of the past because so many of the present spatial patterns owe much to earlier ones, remote sensing & GIS (Geographic Information System) are new market oriented disciplines in Geography various fields of Geography are proposed to be taught in the Syllabus of Bachelor of Studies BS (4-year) Program and M.A/M.Sc (Two years Program).

VISION
Create new vistas and impart knowledge and enhance awareness about the Earth as a living planet with reference to Man-environment Interaction and resulting Physical and Human phenomena amongst the Geography students.

MISSION

  • To make Geography an integral part of education at all levels
  • To enhance the quality of Geographical education for broader applications and implementation in all walks of
    life
  • To make Geography effective for the enhancement of quality of environment and wellbeing of humanity
  • To introduce new applied fields of Geography that can fulfill the requirements of the modern world
  • To make Geographic research effective in our daily lives
  • To broaden Geographic research areas and to effectively integrate it with national planning and development.
  • To create insight appreciating current world affairs based on modern Geographic areas.

PROGRAMS OFFERED

  1. BS (Four-Year)
  2. M. Sc/M.A (Two-Year)
  3. MS/M.Phil

Botanical Garden Herbarium Research Team

Herbarium

HERBARIUM

The development project of Shah Latif University Botanical Garden & Herbarium (SLUBGH) was funded by Higher Education Commission, Islamabad. SLUBGH was upgraded as Centre for Biodiversity & Conservation (CBC) vide approval by the Governor/Chancellor Universities of Sindh on 24th, December, 2009.The collection of this herbarium specimens includes diverse collection of flowering plants, gymnosperms, ferns etc. To brief, the herbarium of today is research, training and service institution that serve as a reference centre, documentation facility and data storehouse. Shah Latif University Herbarium & Botanical Garden have above 5000 specimens.

Scope

1. Store Collections

2. Exchange of Species

3. Botanize the various habitats

Facilities at Shah Latif University Botanical Garden & Herbarium

1. Online Data Bank Access with illustrations

2. Scanning Electron Microscope, Stereo Microscopes, Compound Microscopes, Trinocular Microscopes, Portable Weather Station, GPS etc.

3. Excursions

Prof. Dr. Amir Ahmed Khuhro
Director

INTRODUCTION:


The history of the Department of International Relations is as old as the Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur itself since the establishment in the year 1977. This Department has been imparting quality education to the youth of upper Sindh area of Pakistan. The Department of International Relations has made valuable contribution to the objectives of the teaching and learning of International relations in the society, due to which the Department of International Relations was included one more discipline of Peace and Conflict Studies (PCS) and to upgraded up the level of Institute.

Though the prism of Discipline of international Relations (IR) and Discipline of Peace and Conflict Studies (PCS), the students of Institute of International Relations look the world differently.

Theoretically this institute provides the verity of the knowledge of conservative, liberal and revolutionary world. Each one of these has the lens, through which the world looks different. At the same time these three perspectives can complement each other and the most of the theories draw on all three, but in different proportions.

Understanding International Relations (IR) and Peace and Conflict Studies (PCS) both requires descriptive and theoretical knowledge in post-cold war, new world order, international terrorism, insurgency, global power politics, dispute resolutions, growing number and increasing the role of non state actors, climate change and environment challenges have come on the agenda of Institute of International Relations, which have made it an unavoidable and an inevitable institute.

VISION:

To become one of the leading Institute in providing, quality of education in the Institute of International Relations.

MISSION:

To maintain leadership role in the pursuit of knowledge through, teaching, research and consultancy in the Institute of International Relations.

INTRODUCTION
Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto School of Law was established in 2011 & the classes of the first batch started in April 2012. This School is offering 5 year LLB Program and its Curriculum follows the standards prescribed by the HEC in consultation with the Pakistan Bar Council (PBC), a statutory body to regulate legal profession & legal education in Pakistan. There was no such institution in upper Sindh to offer 5 year LLB program.

This School is offering legal education to train students in all the important subjects of Law, legislative methodology & corporate related legal activities in the field of Information Technology.

SZAB School of Law is offering Masters Program in the field of legislative from academic session 2016. This highly significant academic step is motivated towards the provision of legal education for legal reforms in the context of globalization & the emerging global scenario. In other words this University is endeavoring to set up a program for legal education of International level. This program would offer excellent opportunities to legal professionals in the field of research.

The 5 year BA-LLB program combines BA & LLB degree in creative manner so as to insure greater value and
consistency in the field of Law. Through this program students will obtained a professional degree best up on versatile

DEPARTMENT OF MATHEMATICS

Dr. Ali Dino Jumani Chairman

INTRODUCTION
The Department of Mathematics was established in 1987 and now is one of the fastest growing mathematics departments in the Pakistan. It has an excellent reputation, a strong, demanding program of undergraduate course work with international syllabi offerings and a great postgraduate M.S/MPhil/Ph.D. Mathematics, all in accordance with the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan (HEC) directives. The department of mathematics has committed faculty members keen for progress and eager to emerge in world mathematics scenario; in this effort every faculty member is busy with their international research collaborators in projects with numerous publications. The department of mathematics has sufficient faculty with varied research interests in applied and pure mathematics which cater about over 450+ full-time students in the undergraduate majors program and 50+ in postgraduate MS/M.Phil./ Ph.D. program. Department of Mathematics also offers its services to other departments of the university in the form of teaching mathematics subjects to various faculties and their respective departments ranging from applied algebra and calculus to decision makings of basic statistics and inferential statistics.

VISION

Mathematics develops computational, critical thinking, and problem solving skills. The theory and techniques taught in mathematics courses are especially important in today’s competitive society. The faculty members of the department recognize and strive to ensure the students obtaining this knowledge. At the same time, the faculty contributes to the discipline by fundamental research in pure and applied mathematics.

MISSION
Department of Mathematics envisions ensuring that students will contribute to the society. Students can obtain abilities to critically assess numerical and graphical information; learn to formulate strategies for solving problems; and acknowledge the importance of being intellectually curious throughout their lives.

GOALS

Students/scholars who successfully complete the program should extent the resulting goals:

  • Be able to apply problem solving and logical skills
  • Have a deeper understanding of mathematical theories
  • Have a solid knowledge of applications of Mathematics relates real life problems
  • Be able to communicate mathematical/logical ideas in writing
  • Be competent in computer programming and able to know mathematical packages
  • Be familiar with several subfields of mathematics (e.g, numerical analysis, topology, operations research and CFD).
  • Be exposed to undergraduate research or internship opportunities

  1. BS (Four-Year)
  2. M.Sc. (Two-Year)
  3. MS/M.Phil
  4. Ph.D

Director

INTRODUCTION
I am pleased to welcome you in the Institute of Microbiology. Since its inception with the whole hearted efforts of our faculty members, staff members, students, and researchers, the Institute of Microbiology has constantly remained amaranth Institute of this university. It has unique appearance in history as grows along with university. Institute has 09 renowned research oriented Ph.D faculty members out of 12.

The Institute carries out the fundamental microbiology courses, advanced microbiology courses and multi-disciplinary research programs for the graduate and post graduate students especially in human health and its clinical aspects. More than 120 postgraduate fellows are registered and pursuing for research training in multidisciplinary fields of microbiology. Our Institute also provides the diverse and extensive research programs including Microbial Pathogenesis, Human Health, Microbial Enzymology, Environmental Microbiology, Genetic engineering, Bioinformatics, Epidemiology, Proteomics, Microbial Diversity, Ecology, Modern Biotechnology and so on so forth.

Laboratories in the Institute are well equipped for practical based learning. We take great pride in launching our trainees into successful and productive mainstream careers who are serving in various capacities at different private and public sector of the country and abroad.

This institute has prominent role in the development & growth of the university as it produces number of M.Phil & Ph.D. scholars each year.

title: Mission & Vision
html:
Mission

  • To achieve and attain Quality Standards and become a Model of QEC by providing an outstanding educational environment.
  • Taking measures for capacity building of faculty and supporting staff.
  • Establishing a system to enhance research objectively developed, avoid those policies which encourage malicious activities.

Introduction

The Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC) of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur is determined to improve the quality of education in the University through implementing standards of Quality Assurance Agency, Higher Education Commission Pakistan. The outcome of this exercise is reflected in QAA, HEC ranking of QECs in which SALU retained “W category”. This achievement is the result of commitment of faculty and administration in the light of the Vision & Mission of the university.

The activities of QEC are given below

    • Online feedback on different surveys (Teachers, Students, Course Evaluation, Research Student Progress Review form including Faculty resume), not only reduced the time spent for data collection, analysis, and report generation but also minimized finance and labor.
    • The QEC assists to conduct Graduating Students Surveys, Alumni surveys and Employers survey to improve the quality of program offered under the guidance of all stakeholders. The reports of these surveys are communicated to departments and institutes concerned for the improvement of quality education.
    • Regular capacity building of the teachers to improve teaching methodologies is focused through organizing different workshops and participating in various conferences, seminars and other academic activities on different forums.
    • The QEC has initiated self-assessment process at very beginning in different programs offered by the departments and communicated all relevant documents to HEC as per assessment process.

  • The QEC also works in collaboration with the ORIC regarding Turnitin software for plagiarism detection in scientific reports writing to improve the writing standards as per international requirements so that the old system of cut and paste is discouraged.

  • Keeping in view the above mentioned objectives of the QEC, altogether 31 Self-Assessment Reports (SARs) of BS/MA programs have been completed

Mission

Taking measure for capacity building of faculty and graduation students for result oriented & constrictive changes with new concepts and ideas of education

Vision

To maintain and enhance quality standards and become a model of QEC by providing an outstanding educational environment.

Ultimately his political vision and legal knowledge, Pakistan was established with his untiring efforts. title: 16TH MEETING OF ACADEMIC COUNCIL HELD
html:
Press Release

Khairpur

16TH MEETING OF ACADEMIC COUNCIL HELD

The 16th Meeting of Academic Council of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur was held at University presided over by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto.

Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto welcomed the learned members of Academic Council in the meeting. He said this is highest body of the academic affairs of this University. Dr. Ibupoto maintained that University education in Pakistan is basically is a great privilege and Universities are considered as moral centers of change and social uplift. The existence and the success of Universities ensure the national existence and success of the nation. He said the Universities not only contribute in the economic uplift of the country but also bring about social reforms, enlightenment and intellectual awareness among the masses.

Dr. Ibupoto said it is matter of immense pleasure that Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur fulfill this national responsibility with pride and academic excellence in Northern Sindh Province. The Vice Chancellor said I have not compromised on academic excellence, my team has accepted academic, administrative and financial challenges.

The Members of the Academic Council highly commended the proactive and dynamic administrative, academic and financial efforts taken by the Vice Chancellor for the betterment of the institution. They also appreciated the policy of the Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for adopting the mechanism of transparency and tangible reforms at main campus and its sub-campus. The Members assured the Vice Chancellor that they will render their expertise and services for the enhancement of quality education and better services to the students.

After detailed deliberations, various important decisions were taken. The minutes of 15th Meeting of Academic Council were approved.

The Academic Council awarded PhD Degrees to 25 Research Scholars in different fields and Faculties. title: 69TH BIRTH ANNIVERSARY OF SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO COMMEMORATED
html: 69TH BIRTH ANNIVERSARY OF SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO COMMEMORATEDThe 69th Birth Anniversary of First Lady Prime Minister of Islamic World Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto was commemorated at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur organized by the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Chair. html:
14TH AUGUST INDEPENDENCE DAY COMMEMORATED AT SALU

Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur commemorated 74th Independence Day of Pakistan in simple and graceful way with national enthusiasm, fervor and solemnity at the Central Lawn of the University. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor performed the Flag Hoisting Ceremony national anthem.

While speaking to the participants of the ceremony, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that under the visionary leadership, commitment and struggle of Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah, a separate homeland in the name of Pakistan emerged on the horizon of world map. It is worth mentioning that other prominent and eminent political leadership like Sir Syed Ahmed Khan, Moulana Muhammad Ali Johar, Allama Muhammad Iqbal, Liaquat Ali Khan and others also highly contributed. Dr. Ibupoto said freedom is a blessing of Almighty Allah but we have to pay respect and reverence to freedom. It is high time that we must contribute for the promotion of quality education for our generation with full determination so we could fight against illiteracy and intolerance. Dr. Ibupoto stressed the need to work hard for the nation and state building because Pakistan is our recognition in the comity of the nation. He said Pakistan possesses geo-strategic position in the South Asia. We must concentrate on the development, peace and progress of the country, he added.

Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts & Languages, Prof. Dr. Amir Ali Chandio, Chairman, Department of Political Science, Dr. Inayatullah Bhatti, Incharge Department of Pakistan Studies and Mr. Siraj Ahmed Soomro also shared their views. They said 14th August is an important in the history of Sub-Continent, with the glaring contribution of visionary leadership of Muslims politicians like Sir Syed Ahmed Khan and others promoted the essence of education among the Muslims of the Sub-Continent. They said we must strive for the promotion of education and uphold the unity of the nation.

Prof. Dr. Ghulam Abbas Shar, Dean Faculty of Natural Sciences, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Dr. Mushtaque Jakhrani, Dr. A.D Jumani, Dr. Qasid Mallah, Dr. Liaquat Chandio, Dr. Noor Hassan Chandio, Mr. Ishrat Ali Mirani, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto, Registrar, Syed Munir Shah Rashdi, I.T Manager, Mr. Irfan Ali Phulpoto, PRO, Mr. Ali Hassan Shar and large number of teachers, officers and employees attended the ceremony.

html:
Press Release

Khairpur

BOOK LAUNCHING CEREMONY HELD

A Book Launching Ceremony of “A Hand Book on Economic Diplomacy” written by Mr. Ahmed Ali Sirohey, Ambassador posted at Niger was held at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur organized by the office of the Dean Faculty of Social Sciences. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over the ceremony while Engr. Prof. Dr. Syed Madad Ali Shah, Vice Chancellor Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University of Technology & Skills Development (BBSUTSD), Khairpur, Prof. Dr. Samreen Hussain, Vice Chancellor, Begum Nusrat Bhutto Women University, Sukkur and Mr. Ahmed Ali Sirohey Ambassador posted at Niger were the guests of the honor.

Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said I am trying with my utmost endeavor to uplift the financial, academic and research status of the University. He said our economic resources are progressing day by day. He said, when I joined this University, the monthly salaries and pensions were not paid to the employees. With the blessing of Almighty Allah and teamwork, we are disbursing salaries and pensions on regular basis without any installments and delay. Dr. Ibupoto said that deficit of Rs. 124 Million has been covered during short span of time. Dr. Ibupoto appreciated the academic work of Mr. Ahmed Ali Sirohey. He said this book is a value-added and beneficial for the students of our University.

Engr. Prof. Dr. Syed Madad Ali Shah said this book will be meaningful for the students of International Relations in the field of International Political Economy. Dr. Madad Ali Shah commended the efforts of Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for organizing such academic activity at the campus.

Prof. Dr. Samreen Hussain said that this is part of literary event. She extended her congratulations to the author of the book. Dr. Samreen said this is a healthy sign that our diplomats are producing positive image. It is the need of the time to concentrate on economic diplomacy for the political development, peace and progress, she added.

Mr. Ahmed Ali Sirohey said Pakistan can enhance its outreach through economic diplomacy by using trained practitioner of economic diplomacy by influencing the smartly alliances. He said in modern time, the nature and scope of economic diplomacy has changes. The more soft power has the greater acceptably of the goods and services. He said Japan after Second World War emerged as second largest economy in the world as a part of economic diplomacy. He said we must concentrate on health, tourism, education as economic diplomacy. He said the purpose of writing of this book is basically is to project the country image.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences said that this hand book will equip the students of Department of Economic, Political Sciences, International Relations and other disciplines. He said in future we will foster the academic linkage with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for academic and research collaboration.

Prof. Dr. Muhammad Saleem Rahpoto, Chairman Department of Economics said in this book various economic issues have been highlighted by the author.

Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Director Postgraduate Studies shed light on the historical background of the economic diplomacy. He said economic diplomacy got significance post World War-II. This diplomacy got importance in regional and international scenario. He said CPEC is the success story of economic diplomacy.

The proceedings of the ceremony were conducted by Mr. Muhammad Hassan Shaikh.

The ceremony was attended by the Deans, Directors, Chairmen, Incharges, Sectional Heads and Civil Society Activists.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari
Director, Media & Public Relations
Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur
Dated: 28-06-2021

Clarification

The Spokesperson of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has refuted the perception created by District Reporter of a local daily in which he has attributed that Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto has used indecent words against Shah Abdul Latif University Teachers’ Association (SALUTA) and Employees Welfare Association (EWA) Representatives. The Spokesperson has clarified that the Reporter has exaggerated and miss leaded the facts of interview of the Vice Chancellor.

It is clarified that the Vice Chancellor Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto has always listened the voice of the all stakeholders in a democratic manner and resolved the genuine and legitimate issues of the all teachers, officers, employees and students. The term used in the news item published by the Correspondent “Blackmailing” not uttered by the Vice Chancellor against any person but he narrated in the statement that I firmly believe in the process of dialogue, negotiation and discourse. As result, most of the genuine problems of the all stakeholders have been resolved.

The Spokesperson has clarified that the Vice Chancellor has not interviewed against SALUTA or any person of the University, the interview was solely to apprise the media about the developmental initiatives taken by the Vice Chancellor. The Spokesperson has narrated that although the SALUTA leadership has leveled allegations that Vice Chancellor is using 10 vehicles under his control parked at Vice Chancellor Secretariat but there is only one car which is under the use of the Vice Chancellor as official vehicle/car. It is recalled that the first ever in the history of the Shah Abdul Latif University that Vice Chancellor has fixed the ceiling of POL of this car.

The Spokesperson has maintained that the Vice Chancellor has called upon all the stakeholders to contribute positively in the soft image building of the institution, work together because this institution is our national institution.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari

Director, Media & Public Relations

Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur

title: CONFERENCE ON ROLE OF STUDENTS IN PEACE NARRATIVE CONCLUDED
html: CONFERENCE ON ROLE OF STUDENTS IN PEACE NARRATIVE CONCLUDEDThe Conference on Role of Students in Peace Narrative concluded jointly organized by the Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur and Centre for Health & Gender Equality (CHANGE),Lahore. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor presided over the session while Mr. Saifullah Abro, Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur was the chief guest.Talking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that peace is a part of positive activism. Peace comes from the inner core of the hearts. The core responsibility for the promotion of peace is concerned with the teachers and parents. It is our collective duty to fight against the menace of terrorism and evil forces. Dr. Ibupoto said we have to produce intellectuals to could preach the soft message of peace in the society. Dr. Ibupoto accorded special thanks to Mr. Saifullah Abro who spared his precious time to grace the event. He also acknowledged the efforts of CHANGE for the promotion of peace narrative among the teachers, students and staff at the campus as part of capacity building for peace narrative.Mr. Saifullah Abro said there are four principles for the promotion of peace. Inclusiveness is very essential to take on board all the stakeholders. Protection of right is another principle for the promotion of peace by which we protect the fundamental rights of the people. Efficient service delivery is also principle by which we deliver efficiently for public at large. The forth pillar is development. The judicious development will provide progress on the basis of merit. He said in the absence of these four principles, there is absence of peace. He said there are different threats to peace, weak service delivery, sectarianism, terrorism and crime are major challenges impeding in the way of peace.Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences briefed about the peace project. He said 10 students mobilization seminars related to peace were held in various departments. 2 Two-Days peace narrative trainings conducted with 48 Faculty Members of different departments. Two-Day trainings conducted with 24 hostel administration staff while 3 three-days trainings were conducted with 72 male and female hostel students. facilitated the faculty, hostel staff and students to design the quality actions around peace.27 social action plan carried out i.e. seminars, mushaira, peace walk, cultural program, signature campaign were held.Prof. Dr. Agha Nadia, Director Institute of Gender Studies talked on the Role of Women in Peace Building. She said women are the pioneer of peace because they train their children about the social values, peace and tolerance. She said peace is the outcome of positive mindset. We are striving to promote the soft message of peace in our institution with enthusiasm. Women has contributed positively in the promotion of peace worldwide.Mr. Khadim Hussain Mirani, Executive Director Bhittai Social Watch & Advocacy (BSWA) talked on Role of Civil Society for Engaging Youth in Peace Promotion. Mr. Mirani shed light on the significance of peace. He said in the capacity of civil society activist, we have settled disputes in our area, provided health and education facilities to the people.Syed Akbar Shah, Station Director, Radio Pakistan Khairpur talked on the Role of Radio in Peace Process. He said Radio Pakistan has widely propagated the message of peace and unity. We firmly believe in ethical values. The media is playing positive role in the peace building.Mr. Mumtaz Hussain, Executive Director CHANGE accorded vote of thanks to the Vice Chancellor, Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur and the guests speakers. He said we are striving to promote the basic concept of peace and the capacity building of the youth across the country because educational institutions and youth could play decisive role in the promotion of tolerant and peaceful campuses.Mr. Ali Raza Lashari conducted the proceedings of the program. Appreciation shields were distributed among the organizers and guests.

title: EXTENSION LECTURE ON “GROWING RELIGIOUS INTOLERANCE IN SOCIETY: CAUSES AND PRECAUTIONS” HELD
html:
EXTENSION LECTURE ON “GROWING RELIGIOUS INTOLERANCE IN SOCIETY: CAUSES AND PRECAUTIONS” HELD

An Extension Lecture on “Growing Religious Intolerance in Society: Causes and Precautions” was organized by the Institute of Islamic Studies, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over the lecture program while Prof. Dr. Saifullah Bhutto, from Quaid-i-Awam University of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Nawabshah was the keynote speaker.

Speaking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said Islam is the religion of peace, tolerance and co-existence. He said we have to adopt rational approach to behave properly with the people of the other religions so the concept of live and let live to be accomplished practically. Islam is a universal religion which accepts the existence of other religions. Dr. Ibupoto commended the efforts of the Director Institute of Islamic Studies Dr. Sajjad Ali Raeesi for organizing this extension lecture on very important topic.

Prof. Dr. Saifullah Bhutto said that religion is the source of inspiration. He said it is the time to promote the inter-faith harmony, inter-religious tolerance and acceptance to other religions so the society could be peaceful and tolerant. Dr. Bhutto said process of peace narrative, dialogue and discourse may be preferred in order to avoid any sectarian strife in the society so the religious scholars, media and civil society could play their due role for the tolerant society and the promotion of real essence of religious tolerance so we could avoid from intolerant mindset.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences accorded vote of thanks. He said with the help of good character and patience we could establish religious tolerance in our society.
Earlier, Dr. Sajjad Ali Raeesi, Director Institute of Islamic Studies welcomed the Vice Chancellor and Guests. He also briefed the academic and research activities of the institute and also shed light on the objectives of the extension lecture.

Prof. Dr. Muqarrab Akbar, Prof. Dr. Minhoon Khan Laghari, Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Prof. Dr. Wahid Bux Jatoi, Dr. Santosh Kumar, Dr. Zain-ul-Abideen Arejo, Dr. Inayatullah Bhatti, Dr. Nazar Phulpoto, Dr. Siraj Soomro, large number of teachers, research scholars and students attended the lecture program.

title: Extension Lecture on Human Dignity in the Light of Seerat un Nabi (PBUH)

title: FIRST EVER STUDENTS SOCIETIES SERVICE CENTRE HANDED OVER TO SALU
html:
The First Ever Students Societies Service Centre among the approximately 235 Public and Private Universities of Pakistan generously established with the help of USAID was handed over to Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur. The handing and taking over ceremony was held in the presence of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto.

Talking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said it is matter of immense pleasure and rejoice for me that an state of art building has been constructed at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur by USAID. As per it’s mandate of agreement, a Monitoring Committee was constituted consisting on Pro-Vice Chancellor Ghotki Campus, Registrar, Project Director (Works) and National Coordinator IUCPSS. He said different societies have been established in order to inculcate the concept of national integration, unity and cohesion among the students.

html:

HEC through its initiative Digital Learning and Skills Enrichment Initiative(DLSEI)” intends to provide an opportunity to students and faculty members of Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) to secure Certifications from world-renowned universities, which will enhance their learning capabilities and skills for professional development. A verified certificate from a world-renowned online platform can serve as proof for an employer that someone is abreast with cutting-edge tools and skills needed for a competitive career globally.”For further details, please click https://dlsei.hec.gov.pk/courses/searchNote: Registration will be on the first come first serve basis within each university stipulated quota. Therefore all the students and faculty members are advised to visit the office of the IT Manager (Focal person of the program) for registration with following details:1. Name 2. F/Name 3. CNIC 4. Uni Name 5. Roll Num 6. Program 7. Department 8. Semester 9. Campus 10. Email 11. Contact Number 12. Payment received 13. Courses of Interest 14. Disabled (yes/no)15. title: INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON CHEMICAL SCIENCES: A MULTIDISCIPLINARY APPROACH CONCLUDED
html:
INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON CHEMICAL SCIENCES: A MULTIDISCIPLINARY APPROACH CONCLUDED

International Conference on Chemical Sciences: A Multidisciplinary Approach (ICCS-MA)-2022 organized by the Institute of Chemistry, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur in collaboration with Sindh Higher Education Commission, Karachi concluded. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over the concluding session of the conference. Prof. Dr. Tufail Ahmed Sheerazi, Director Centre for Excellence of Chemistry, University of Sindh, Jamshoro was the chief guest.

Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that conferences always provide a viable platform in order to learn and transform knowledge, skills and expertise. We have provided congenial and conducive environment to our Faculty Members, Research Scholars and Students for embarking research and innovation. Dr. Ibupoto assured the galaxy of scholars that the proceedings of the conference will be published and the recommendations of the conference will be communicated to the relevant quarters. The Vice Chancellor appreciated the efforts of Prof. Dr. Mushtaque Jakhrani, Director Institute of Chemistry and Organizing Committee for organizing this conference in befitting manner.

Prof. Dr. Tufail Ahmed Sheerazi said this University was established after the name of legend and prominent Sufi Saint Hazrat Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai who’s message is for love, peace and progress. The land of Khairpur is fertile in terms of education, culture and literature. He said that the research is a collaborative endeavor. This is the need of the time to concentrate on quality research, commercialization and industrial linkage. He appreciated the contribution of research scholars of national and international repute especially the young research scholars presented their research papers in excellent manner. He commended the efforts of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for his in-depth interest in the promotion of education and research at the campus.

Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Acting Dean Faculty of Natural Sciences said that this conference was multidimensional because this age is the age of multidisciplinary approach. He said that conference emerged as consortium in order to foster future linkages. He advised to the Director Institute of Chemistry to launch research journal in the Institute of Chemistry.

Prof. Dr. Mushtaque Jakhrani briefed that more than 66 research papers were presented in parallel sessions. He said the eminent scholars from Azerbijan, China, USA, Sudan, Malaysia and Pakistan participated and presented their research papers in the conference. He said that we will work in the same spirit to embark research and development in the Institute. Dr. Jakhrani commended the untiring efforts of Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for providing patronage and support in the success of the event.

Dr. Yagut Yusifova from Azerbaijan, Dr. Eltayeb Fadul from Khartoum Sudan, Dr. Saifullah Bullo and Dr. Ambreen Rehana Solangi shared their views. They said this was a marvelous conference and provided ample opportunities to share expertise, views and best practices in the field of chemical sciences. They appreciated the hospitality extended by the University administration especially they appreciated the keen interest of Vice Chancellor Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto in the organizing this international moot.

Prof. Dr. Wahid Bux Jatoi presented the recommendations of the conference. The same will be communicated to the concerned forums.

Dr. Qurat-ul-Ain Shaikh, Conference Secretary presented vote of thanks. She extended the especial thanks to the participants of national and international delegates and Sindh Higher Education Commission, Karachi for sponsoring the conference. She also extended her thanks to the University administration, Organizing Committee, Volunteers and Media Persons.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Prof. Dr. Amir Ali Chandio, Prof. Dr. Minhoon Khan Laghari, Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Prof. Dr. Tajnees Pirzada, Prof. Dr. Masihuulah Jatoi, Prof. Dr. Farman Ali Mangi, Dr. Mujeeb-ur-Rehman Abro, Mr. Ishrat Ali Mirani and large numbers of teachers, research scholars and students attended the concluding session.

title: INTERNATIONAL MOTHER LANGUAGE DAY ORGANIZED AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KAHIRPUR
html:
INTERNATIONAL MOTHER LANGUAGE DAY ORGANIZED AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KAHIRPUR

An International Mother Language Day was organized at the Institute of English Language & Literature, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over by Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice-Chancellor.

Speaking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that languages are a major tool to communicate and Mother languages directly reaches the heart. He said that its prestigious to speak in one’s own language. But unfortunately, today’s generation is feeling shame in speaking their own language. He appreciated the students for their beautiful performances.

Prof. Dr. Zulfiqar Ali Shah, Director Institute of English Language & Literature highlighted the importance of mother languages and shed light on the status of Sindhi language according to ethnologies of languages.

Mr. Abdul Qadir Dayo, along with his team, presented the digital story on variation in Sindhi language. Mr. Azhar, Ms Iqra, with their teams, presented the adaptation of G.B Shah’s drama Pygmalion in Sindhi language. Ms Masooma Inayat and Mr. Sajjad Gul presented their skit on Sindhi Boli. MS Hafsa, Ms Masooma and their team presented their documentary on languages spoken in. Pakistan. Ms, Soohan, Ms, Kanwal, Mr. Jawad, Ms Seema, Ms, Aysha delivered their speeches. Ms Soohan Soomro and Talha Channa were hosts of the event. Mr. Abdul Rasheed Soomro read poetry of Shah Abdul Latif Bhitiai to show his love for Sindhi Language.

Mr. Tanveer Hussain Mangnejo, the organizer of the event lauded the efforts of the students who participated in program. He also highlighted the importance of linguistic diversity and the role of the youth in it. Prof. Mukesh Kumar said that our students have once again proved that they can be torch bearers of mother languages. He stressed upon the use of mother languages.

Prof. Dr. Gulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts & Languages, Prof. Dr Ameer Ali Chandio, Chairman Political Science, Prof. Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Prof. Ishrat Ali Mirani, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto, Registrar and large number of faculty members and students attended the program.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari

Director, Media & Public Relations

Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur

Dated: 23-02-2022

title: KASHMIR SOLIDARITY DAY OBSERVED AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KHAIRPUR
html:
KASHMIR SOLIDARITY DAY OBSERVED AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KHAIRPUR

The Kashmir Solidarity Day was organized by the Directorate of Students Affairs, the Leaders Departmental Societies and Institute of International Relations.

Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts and Languages presided the event.

Talking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori remarked that Kashmir issue is an international issue. Indian Government has committed brutality, genocide and agression in the Kashmir valley. People are facing miserable conditions under siege and search. The muslim world is silent spectator on this issue, though muslim world posseses rich oil sources and political power. He said that we, the muslims, are not united. So we are facing the painful conditions day by day. He stressed the need for promotion of education, technology and knowledge for our better society.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences said that so called Indian secular policy and undemocratic approach has not given the right of self,determination to kashmiri people. He appealed the world community to support the genuine cause of Kashmiri people.

Ms. Shaherbano, Mr. Rashid Ali, Ms. Saba Dharejo, Mr. Shahid Kalhoro and Mr. Aqib Shar, the students of the Institute of I.R and different Societies also spoke on the occasion. They shed the light on the gensis of kashmiri issue, struggles of the kashmiri leaders and they appreciated the role of govt of pakistan for highlighting the Kashmir issue at International Forums and UN platform.

The Human Chain was also made in solidarity with the kashmiri people.

The proceedings of the event were conducted by Mr. Ishrat Ali Mirani. He also appreciated the encouraging role of Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for organizing the National Day.

Prof. Dr. Muhmmad Saleem Rahpoto, Prof.Dr. Amir Ali Shar, Mr. Tanveer Hussain Mangnejo, Mr. Mujeeb Jan Talpur, Dr. Hakim Sahito, Dr. Parvez Ahmed Mahesar, Mr.Aijaz Siyal, Mr. Ali Raza Lashari Mr. Muhammad Younis Phulpoto, Mr. Rajab Chandio and large number of students and staff attended the event.

html:
KHALIL AHMED IBUPOTO EXTENDED HIS FELICITATION ON THE COMPLETION OF 10 YEARS OF ACADEMIC JOURNEY OF IUCPSS

Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has extended his felicitation to Mr. Muhammad Murtaza Noor, National Coordinator for Inter-University Consortium for the Promotion of Social Sciences (IUCPSS) on the completion of 10 years academic journey.

Dr. Ibupoto said the IUCPSS has completed 10 years dynamic services for uplifting the academic, trainings and capacity building of the Faculty Members and Students. During the 10 years span of time, IUCPSS has contributed significantly. Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur is founding member of this forum. The IUCPSS has established Student Societies Service Building in order to equip the youth to play their pivotal role in the co-curricular activities. Dr. Ibupoto said that the establishment of National Students Societies Network under the ambit of IUCPSS is also a remarkable development. It is recalled that the Faculty of Social Sciences has adopted the course on Social & Religious Tolerance in its 8 teaching institutes and departments.

Dr. Ibupoto remarked that the 20 Faculty Members of SALU were trained at Lahore in a local hotel. The IUCPSS has organized series of seminars, extension lectures, workshops and conferences on different themes at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur. Dr. Ibupoto maintained that I am optimistic that the Consortium will render its academic and co-curricular activities for capacity building of Faculty Members and Students of University and other members Universities and the future collaboration with Consortium will remain continue with the same spirit.

title: MEET THE PRESS HELD AT SALU
html: MEET THE PRESS HELD AT SALU Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur addressed meet the press held at University to apprise the Media Persons, Civil Society Activists and Well Wishers of the University about the tangible efforts taken by him during his period from 02 October 2020 till date and in the wake of the strike of Employees Welfare Association on the plea of their charter of Demand.Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur is the third largest premier Higher Education Institution of Sindh catering the academic needs of the students belongs to below poverty line imparting quality higher education. It is immense pleasure and proud for me that thousands of the students are rendering their services in every section of the life in befitting manner. Since, I joined this prestigious institution on 2nd October 2020, the following developments have been taken place.Formation of Deans Committee in order to participate in the academic matters of the University, Establishment of Campus Management Cell for the better governance of the University, Establishment of Beautification Cell aimed at to provide clean and green environment at the campus, Establishment of Fund Raising and University Image Building Committee in order to avail the funds from the philanthropists and government sectors, Strengthening the Disciplinary Committee. The purpose of this committee aimed at to maintain the discipline among the students, Conflict Management Committee. This Committee aimed at to manage the internal conflict among the stakeholders at campus, Establishment of F.M Radio, Establishment of Command and Control System.Dr. Ibupoto said that when I joined as Vice Chancellor, the salaries to the staff was not paid. Even they managed protest at the Press Club, Khairpur during the Eid Days. Now the salaries and pensions are being disbursed timely on 1st Day of the every month. Recently, Rs. 230 Million Pensionary Benefits among the retired staff from grade 02 to grade 22 have been disbursed pending from year 2017 to 2021. By taking drastic cut in the expenditure, we have controlled the deficit of Rs. 224 Million.On academic side, we have signed number of Memorandum of Understandings (MoUs) and Research and Development (R&D) Organizations to foster the academic linkage and for the promotion of research culture. During the month of November and December 2021, we have organized two international conferences in the Department of Geography and Department of Political Science.Vice Chancellor briefed the media persons about the new initiatives taken by the University Administration, two new buildings have been made functional, Sweet water and games for students hostels, Sun Shade for students, 50 Need based Scholarships have been availed from the Government of Sindh. First Ever Child Care Center, regular monitoring of students canteen, USAID students center, computer in various sections, Biometric Machines Installed, Repair of Boys & Girls Hostels. Vice Chancellor also briefed the future plans to the media persons, Construction of Girls & Boys Hostels, Installation of ATM Machine for Girls & Families septetly, Establishment of Girls Gymnasium, and Chairs PC-I.Dr. Ibupoto remarked that during the last 10 days, the Office Bearers of Employees Welfare Association on the plea of their charter of demand have launched strike. It is recalled that University administration constituted a Negotiation Committee consisting of 5 Members including Dean Faculty of Social Sciences as its Convener. The office bearers of Employees Welfare Association raised objection on the inclusion of 2 Members who are the Members of the Syndicate and they escape from the negotiation process. Different times, they were invited to hold dialogue with the negotiation committee but they refused. As result, a fresh committee was constituted on their demand but they declined to continue the process of dialogue. On Thursday 16-12-2021, a delegation of different panels met with the Vice Chancellor and presented same charter of demand in the presence of the some members of the Negotiation Committee. The talks were concluded successfully. The following actions have been taken in the backdrop of the dialogue. Release of 50% of Enhanced Salary as announced by the Government. The arrears of 50% have been released to the employees from BPS-02 to BPS-16 on 17-12-2021. The release of Rs. 2000 as Jersey Allowance has also been paid to the lower staff of class IV has been paid. Part time allowance to Drivers have been issued by the Registrar office on 17-12-2021 on the need basis as recommended by the Senior Transport Officer. The fresh Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) have been notified and its meeting has been fixed on 5th January 2021 in order to promote the employees from BPS-02 to BPS-16 as per rules. For Regularization of Adhoc Employees appointed on Diseased Quota, the Registrar office has issued a notification for calling a progress report from the relevant section where they are performing their duties. After examining their cases they will get their regular orders. The University has appointed 18 real heirs of Diseased Employees as per their Qualification and also appointed 6 Lady Teachers in Model School on the demand of Employees Welfare Association. On the demand of Employees Welfare Association, Medical Health Insurance Committee has been constituted, wherein, the General Secretary of Employees Welfare Association also included as its Member. The draft of the policy has been prepared and placed in the agenda of the next meeting of Syndicate. On the demand of the Employees, Medical Advisory Committee has been constituted to recommend the cases of medical bills of employees. 30 Employees as per technical policy as first instance have been awarded 2 higher grades. The revised salary is being disbursed to employees. 30 % of Leave Encashment to all employees from BPS-2 to BPS-22 has been paid. All Chowkidars have been paid their arrears. House Building Loans of Rs. Of 50,000 each have been paid to 100 Employees. All the employees who are holding technical posts are given technical allowance. Rs. 1,000 Utility allowance has been paid to all the employees from BPS-2 to BPS-16. Driving Allowance has been allowed Rs. 1250 per month to the Drivers. All Pakistan Tour has been restored for Employees.Dr. Ibupoto said that the some of the problems are the jurisdiction of statuary bodies i.e. Finance Planning Committee, Syndicate, and Senate will be resolved as per policy. It is pathetic that 7 Employees were involved in the preparation of bogus slips during the Annual Examinations 2020. On the complaint of aggrieved candidates a Fact Finding and Inquiry Committee was constituted on the Senior Professor and Officers of the University, as result the 7 employees were found involved in fraudulent, forgery, manipulation and issuance of bogus slips and looted the innocent candidates. On the basis of the reports of The Facts Findings Committee the matter was placed in the last meeting of Syndicate. The Members of the Syndicate unanimously decided to place their services suspended. Meanwhile, a high powered inquiry committee consisting on the 4 Syndicate Members has been constituted further to probe the matter in detail.This is the reaction of suspension of 7 Employees. The most of the problems have been resolved. Some problems are related with the finance as soon as funds will be released, their problems will be resolved accordingly.In the wake of the current situation, I appeal the media persons, civil society, well wishers of the University to raise voice against the strike culture so the institution could advanced and emerge as leading institution of the region as well as world.Dr. Ibupoto said that we have always adopted open door policy and firmly believe in dialogue and discourse. Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Deans of Faculty of Arts & Languages, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Director Media & Public Relations, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto Registrar, and Mr. Nisar Ahmed Noonari, Director Finance attended the Press Conference.

title: Meeting of Organizing Committee of Three-Day International Conference on Climate Change and Traditional Agriculture Pattern in Pakistan: Implication and Solution Held
html:
Meeting of Organizing Committee of Three-Day International Conference on Climate Change and Traditional Agriculture Pattern in Pakistan: Implication and Solution Held

A meeting of the Organizing Committee of Three-Day International Conference on “Climate Change and Traditional Agriculture Pattern in Pakistan: Implication and Solution” being organized by the Department of Geography was held at Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur presided over by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto.

Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that agriculture production is one of the major challenges of the 21st Century in the era of global environmental problem such as climate change. In the current situation, climate change is a major threaten to agriculture sector. It has adverse effect on agro economic system. Agriculture is one of the largest sector that sustain livelihood.
The Vice Chancellor said that the Department of Geography is holding third consecutive international conference so it is matter of rejoice for me.

Dr. Noor Hassan Chandio, Incharge Department of Geography briefed the house that conference will be held on 26-28 October 2021 on various themes i.e. climate change and water crisis, climate change and agriculture pattern, water management and agriculture, flood and disasters, climate change and new seed varieties. He revealed that 55 scholars will present their research papers. Professors and Scholars from Egypt, China and Turkey will participate in the conference. During the inaugural ceremony, the Vice Chancellors of different Universities of Sindh will grace the occasion. At the Concluding Ceremony, Provincial Minister for Climate Change, Coastal Development and Universities & Boards Mr. Muhammad Ismail Raho will be the chief guest.
The pre- arrangements of conference were reviewed thoroughly in order to organize the conference in briefing manner.
Prof. Dr. Mumtaz Hussain Mahar, Dean Faculty of Physical Sciences, Prom Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Prof. Dr. Amir Ali Chandio, Prof. Dr. Qasid Mallah, Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto, Registrar, Syed Muneer Shah, I.T Manager and Members of Organizing Committee attended the meeting.

title: MEETING REGARDING THE OPENING OF UNIVERSITY WAS HELD
html:
MEETING REGARDING THE OPENING OF UNIVERSITY WAS HELD

A Review Meeting of the Deans of Faculties and Academic Heads of Institutes and Departments was held at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur regarding the opening of University and conduct of Classes of Second Semester-2022. The meeting was chaired by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto.

Talking to the participants of the meeting, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said Sindh has ravaged devastating flood occured by heavy rains. It has also damaged the educational institutions as result, education has suffered a lot. He said with my team, we have taken measures for dewatering, minor repair as far as major maintenance and repair is concerned, the PC-I has been prepared and sent to the concerned quarters for rehabilitation of University.

After detailed deliberations, it was decided that University will reopen from Monday September 19, 2022. The Point Buses will also ply only on clear roads links. Moreover Academic Roadmap for the ongoing Second Semester Examinations was also decided. The Mid-Term Test will start from October 31 to November 04, 2022 while the Final Test of Second Semester will commence from December 16, 2022 to January 05, 2023. The Directors, Chairmen, and Deans will ensure the proper conduct of the classes.

The meeting was attended by Deans of Faculties, Directors, Chairmen, Incharges and Sectional Heads.

title: PEOPLE’S ASSEMBLY ON SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT THROUGH GREEN FINANCING HELD AT SALU
html:
People’s Assembly on Sustainable Development through Green Financing held at Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur jointly organized by the Marvi Rural Development Organization (MRDO) in collaboration with Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur and Indus Consortium. Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari Dean Faculty of Social Sciences presided over the event.

Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari said with the increased share of renewable for energy solutions at community and industrial needs with sustainable finance by public and private sector will help to mitigate the climate effects and reduce it’s adverse impact for marganalized segments of the society as well as to ensure sustainable development in Pakistan. Dr. Lashari commended the untiring efforts of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for promoting the co-curricular activities at the campus and also lauded the efforts of MRDO for the capacity building of the community and youth.

Advocate Manzoor Hussain Larik, Dean Faculty of Law siad it is the institutional responsibility to implement the laws to curb the menace of degradation because it is need of the time that strict legislation may be made for the better friendly environment. He said though it is collective responsibility of all state organs be forwarded to plant trees so the adverse impact of climate change may be mitigated.

Dr. Noor Hassan Chandio, Incharge Department of Geography said that mashroom growth of urbanization has created environmental degradation, uneven town planning has adversely affected the environment. The agriculture land is being shrunked day by day.

Mr. Mushtaque Hussain Soomro, Deputy Director Agriculture Khairpur said that the climate change has adversely affected the yeild of the crops owing to lake of forestation. There is acute shortage of rain fall.

Dr. Inayatullah Bhatti, Incharge Department of Pakistan Studies said that if we will not control the uneven planning of the housing societies as result in our area we will face the shortage of good quality of Khairpur dates.

Mr. Ali Raza Lashari also shared his views that tree plantation may be launched as campaign jointly by individuals and institutions.

Mr. Hassan Jarwar, CEO Indus Consortium and Ms. Faiza Qureshi appreciated the current government which has considerably increased climate related budget Rs. 412 Million in 2018- 2019 while Rs. 8075 Million in the year 2019-20.

Mr. Salman Ali Program Manager MRDO said that State Bank of Pakistan may ask banks to adhere the green banking guidelines and don’t fund any project which potentially could harm environment. He suggested that wind and solar projects may be encouraged.

At the end, the participants re-afirmed the commitment for the protection of plants and echo system.
excerpt: People’s Assembly on Sustainable Development through Green Financing held at Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur jointly organized by the Marvi Rural Development Organization (MRDO) in collaboration with Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpu

title: PH.D OPEN DEFENSE SEMINAR WAS HELD IN THE DEPARTMENT OF PAKISTAN STUDIES
html: Ph. D Open Defense Seminar was held in the Department of Pakistan Studies, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto. Ph. D Research Scholar Mr. Siraj Ahmed Soomro successfully defended his research on the topic “Democratic Elitism-Conflict and Consensus: An Analytical Study of General Pervez Musharraf Era 1999-2008” under the supervision of Prof. (Retd.) Dr. Imdad Hussain Sahito and co-supervision of Prof. Dr. Amir Ahmed Khuhro. On this occasion, Mr. Siraj Ahmed Soomro said my research was focused on the General Pervez Musharraf Rule and Conflict faced by him during his tenure. He said however, General Musharraf tried to develop consensus on certain political issues wherein political elites sometime developed consensus and also sometime created conflict. These ups and downs of his rule were investigated during the course of my research work. He said there were four big challenges faced by him which were Pakistan not to become rogue state, Democratization, Poverty reduction and Militancy.Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto while delivering his presidential remarks said that the research work of the scholar is up to the mark and a novel work in the field of Pakistan Studies. This research work will pave the way for the policy makers and institutions. The scholar has portrayed the political scenario of that period. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that we are striving to provide better facilities to our research scholars in order to embark their research work on modern lines, he added.Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences remarked that the scholar has accomplished his research work in line with the minimum eligibility criteria laid down by the Higher Education Commission, Islamabad. He said the work of the research scholar will be a value-added for the Faculty of Social Sciences.Prof. (Retd.) Dr. Imdad Hussain Sahito, Prof. Dr. Syed Aftab Ahmed Gillani, Prof. Dr. Muhammad Farooque also shared their views on the research work presented by the scholar. They lauded the untiring efforts of incumbent Vice Chancellor Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for the promotion of research culture at the campus.The proceedings of the seminar were conducted by Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Director Postgraduate Studies. The seminar was declared successful.A large number of teachers and research scholars attended the Open Defense Seminar.Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad LashariDirector Media & Public RelationsShah Abdul Latif University, KhairpurDated: – 30-08-2021

title: Press Release
html:
Press Release

Khairpur

The Spokesperson of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has strongly condemned the harsh and humiliating act of President Shah Abdul Latif University Teachers Association (SALUTA) Prof. Dr. Akhtiar Ali Ghumro, General Secretary Prof. Dr. Hissamuddin Shaikh, Dr. Mujeeb ur Rehman Abro, Dr. Siraj Ahmed Soomro and Mr. Ahmed Ali Memon entered today i.e. Monday June 06, 2022 in the office of the most senior and learned Dean Faculty of Arts and Languages Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori. They used abusive and immoral language against the Dean and threatened him to vacate his office immediately. On the plea that you have opposed the item for counting the teaching experience of Teaching Assistants in the advent of 84th Meeting of Syndicate.

The Spokesperson has maintained that all learned and respected Members of Syndicate are equal having right to express their point of view either far or against or even to submit their note of dissent, disagreement and observation as per rules of business of Syndicate enshrined in the University Act. The Spokesperson has said that it is tantamount to disgrace and humiliate the dignity of the learned member. The Spokesperson has said that the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto has expressed his dismay and sorrow over this situation created by the above group of the teachers. While the majority of the teaching fraternity is supporting the action taken by the incumbent Vice Chancellor in the interest of the Institution and staff.

The Spokesperson has lemanted that this indecent action is creating obstacles in the transparent and timely conduct of forthcoming Selection Board in which a large number of teacher’s cases for promotion/appointment will be recommended to the Syndicate.

Spokesperson
Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur
Dated: 06-06-2022

The Spokesperson of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has clarified regarding the protest of staff of the University owing to non-payment of monthly salary of July 2022. title: PROF. DR. KHALIL AHMED IBUPOTO ATTENDED SECOND VICE CHANCELLORS CONFERENCE
html: PROF. DR. KHALIL AHMED IBUPOTO ATTENDED SECOND VICE CHANCELLORS CONFERENCE Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur attended the Second National Vice Chancellors and Director Student Affairs Conference held at Islamabad organized by the Inter-University Consortium for the Promotion of Social Sciences (IUCPSS).Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto shared his views and participated in the deliberation of the conference. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that the efforts of IUCPSS are highly commendable for the capacity building, academic linkages, sharing of expertise and best practices at the University level. He said the outcome of the conference will be benefited for the Tolerant and Peaceful University Campuses because youth is an agent of change in our society. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that the first ever National Student Societies Network has been established with the dynamic support of IUCPSS and the proactive role of Mr. Muhammad Murtaza Noor, National Coordinator IUCPSS is highly laudable in this regard.It is recalled that during the two days course of deliberations, overview of Azm-e-Pakistan activities at university campuses aimed at strengthening student societies/clubs was also shared. Panel and group discussions on the topics of student societies for peace building and role of faculty members/university administration in peace building were held. The participant Vice Chancellors and representatives of the Universities appreciated the efforts and various initiatives undertaken to promote values of peace, co-existence, harmony, responsible citizenship at university campuses.In the wake of conference, a declaration was signed by the vice chancellors and representatives of the universities, it was agreed to join National Student Societies/Clubs Network and Inter University Alliance on Student Activities , organizing inter-university students activities and competitions, sharing best practices, expertise, knowledge and experience on effective engagement of students, award of Roll of Honour to acknowledge the talented students in co-curricular activities and extending cooperation in other areas of mutual interest related to effective engagement of students at university campuses. It is recalled that so far more than 50 universities have given their written consent to join National Student Societies Network.Prof. Dr. Atta ur Rahman Chairman Prime Minister ‘s Task Force on Science and Technology highlighted importance of effective engagement of students through strengthening student societies/clubs at university campuses, promoting inter-university collaborations and organizing inter university co-curricular activities/competitions.Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ali Shah Chairman Vice Chancellors Committee remarked that if we want our students to get opportunities in life, they should be active members of campus based student societies/clubs as employers also prefer those students with experiences in societies.

The Spokesperson has clarified that their version and stance is irrational and illogical. This is in the history of 33 years that such practice of fair play has been adopted by the University Authorities to convey the gray areas to the aspirant candidats. These candidates are invited to represent their version regarding their eligiblity before the Scrutiny Committee chaired by Worthy Vice Chancellor on 17-18 February 2022 wherein the President and General Secretary of SALUTA will be available.The Spokesperson has maintained that the process of scrutiny was made in a transparent and judicious way. It is recalled that on last Friday, the meeting of Executive Council of SALUTA was held with the Vice Chancellor. In this meeting, it was decided that the list of eligible and not eligible candidates will be dispatched to the concerned. Meanwhile, the list of Experts will also be sent to the Registrar Office on or before 15 February 2022. After assurance from the Administration, the SALUTA Representatives promised that they will call off the protest, but today they continued sit-in in front of Administration Block. This is tantamount a breach made by the Executive Council SALUTA.The Spokesperson has appealed the teaching fraternity to continue their academic and research work inline with their national duty.

GHULAM ABBAS SHARA Farewell Reception was hosted by the Vice Chancellor Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto in the honor of Dean Faculty of Natural Sciences Prof. Dr. Ghulam Abbas Shar on attaining his age of superannuation as Professor.Speaking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said the academic, research and administrative services of Prof. Dr. Ghulam Abbas Shar are highly commendable. He performed his duties with devotion and commitment. The Vice Chancellor remarked that he always guided me in the strengthening the academic and research culture at the University. He remained a good member of my team. Dr. Ibupoto said the retirement is the part of the life. I am optimistic that Dr. Shar will continue his research activities for the benefit of community and nation.Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts & Languages, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Prof. Dr. Mumtaz Ali Junejo, Dean Faculty of Management Sciences, Prof. Dr. Pir Bux Ghumro, Prof. Dr. Mushtaque Jakhrani, Prof. Dr. Abdul Hussain Shar, Prof. Dr. Khalida Mahar, Dr. Shamroz Shaito, Dr. Parvez Mahesar, Dr. Gul Afshan Soomro, Dr. Nazar Kalwar, Dr. Bhajan Lal, Miss Asia Ruk and others also spoke on the meritorious services rendered by Dr. Ghulam Abbas Shar. They said. Dr. Shar is a dedicated professor produced sizeable number of Ph. D Scholars. He is polite person, his attitude remained friendly with colleagues and students. Dr. Shar is versatile personality and soft spoken person. He encouraged the students in their pursuit of academic excellence. Dr. Shar remained helping hand to guide the students.Prof. Dr. Ghulam Abbas Shar said my first career started as Lecturer in the Chemistry subject at the Govt. Degree College, Moro. I taught with dedication and commitment to the students. He said I strengthened the Department of Chemistry by providing scientific equipments. He said I believe in proficiency. I remained the first Director ORIC. I earned different research projects as result University’s image developed academically. He appreciated the untiring efforts of Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor for promoting academic, research and development of University. The efforts of Vice Chancellor are remarkable for bringing the culture of merit and transparency.A large number of teachers and research scholars attended the reception.

title: REVIEW MEETING FOR THE PRE ARRANGEMENTS FOR PRE-ENTRY TEST 2022 HELD
html: REVIEW MEETING FOR THE PRE ARRANGEMENTS FOR PRE-ENTRY TEST 2022 HELDA Review Meeting for the Pre-Arrangements for the conduct of Pre-Entry Test-2022 was held at Vice Chancellor Secretariat, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor chaired the meeting.Talking to the participants of the meeting, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto remarked that the Pre-Entry Test-2022 will be conducted on Tuesday 11 January 2022 for the fresh batch of B.S Part-I and B.S Part-III respectively. The Vice Chancellor said that the conduct of centralized admission test aimed at to maintain transparency and discipline.After detailed deliberations, it was decided that the Pre-Entry Test will be conducted at the Central Lawn of the Main Administration Block. The eligible candidates will download their admit slips from University website www.salu.edu.pk . Meanwhile, the admit slips will also be available during the first week of January 2022 in the all institutes and departments. The parents of the appearing candidates will be seated at the University Model School. It was decided that entry of the candidates will be allowed only from the Main Gate having admit slips. The outsiders will not be allowed to enter in the University premises. Wherein, all the hostels will remain closed. It was decided that stringent and foolproof security measures will be taken in order to avert any untoward incident. The District Police will be approached to maintain law and order. The traffic plan will be prepared by the University Security Staff with the support of District Police. It was also decided that all the Faculty Members, .S and Teaching Assistants will perform their invigilation duties on day of test. The test will start on 11:00 am to 12:00 Noon.Prof. Dr. Mumtaz Hussain Mahar, Convener Hall Management Committee, Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Convener Admissions Committee, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Prof. Dr. Noor Ahmed Shaikh, Prof. Dr. Ikhtiar Ali Ghumro, Prof. Dr. Mushtaque Jakhrani, Prof. Dr. Samina Rajpar, Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto, Registrar, Mr. Shahid Danwar Director Admissions, Mr. Farhan Latif Memon, Mr. Shahid Mahar and others attended the meeting.
