title: SUMMER SCHOOL ON “ROLE OF ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS IN DEMOCRATIC CONSOLIDATION, SOCIAL JUSTICE AND CONFLICT TRANSFORMATION IN PAKISTAN
html: SUMMER SCHOOL ON “ROLE OF ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS IN DEMOCRATIC CONSOLIDATION, SOCIAL JUSTICE AND CONFLICT TRANSFORMATION IN PAKISTANBhittai Social Watch and Advocacy (BSWA), Khairpur in partnership with Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur, FES Pakistan, Media Training Resource Centre (MTRC) and University of Peshawar organized a Summer School on “Role of Academic Institutions in Democratic Consolidation, Social Justice and Conflict Transformation in Pakistan” at University of Peshawar (Baragali Campus) Abbottabad. Total 20 sessions were conducted in which eminent scholars, social, cultural icons and academicians conducted key sessions. The main objective of this summer school was to bring together diversity of Pakistani culture and promote ideals of peace and harmony. The inaugural session was presided by Prof. Dr. Nasir Jamal Khattak, Vice Chancellor, University of Swabi while Dr Neils, Country Director FES Pakistan, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, SALU, Mr. Khadim Hussain Mirani, Executive Director BSWA and Prof. Dr. Shahjehan Syed, CEO, MTRC graced the occasion as guests of honour.The speakers shedding light on their respective topics underlined the significance of durable peace in the region. They expressed without the establishment of peace and tranquility we can never prosper. For last several years, Pakistan has faced continuous waves of extremism and terrorism which has tarnished the image of the country globally. People are full of intolerance and they react quickly even on the petty issues. The Summer School aimed at to inculcate the core values of religious tolerance, mutual respect and peace. We have to change the content of the syllabus if we want to educate the young generation to develop heights of tolerance and harmony. It is need of the time to promote the essence of democracy and bring the people for social cohesion, promotion of social justice and equity in the society.The concluding ceremony of this event was chaired by Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur. Dr. Ibupoto said, “The students of Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur have brought a message of peace to the land of Rahman Baba, a great Sufi poet of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. These types of practical sessions on peaceful coexistence and cultural diversity can bridge the gap of differences. He said the role of academic institutions in democratic consolidation is vital for academic peace. The Vice Chancellor said I am glad to announce that our University will host winter school in Khairpur where cultural colours of different provinces will be showcased”. Certificates were distributed among the participants.Senior Parliamentary Expert, Dr. Irfan Ashraf, Dr. Nasser Ali Khan, Director Pak-Austria Fachhochschule and former Vice Chancellor of University of Haripur, Adv. Dileep Kumar Doshi, Shahzada Zulfiqar, President Pakistan Federal Union of Journalists, Sabookh Syed, Mr. Zafarullah Khan, Dr Samina Afridi, Ms. Quratulain Zahid, Prof. Hassan Shaikh and Mr. Ali Raza Lashari set out their presentations. The proceedings of the different sessions were conducted by Mr. Abdullah Dayo, Program Coordinator of FES, Pakistan. Sufi singer Ayaz Mallah sang Sufi songs to disseminate the soft message of Sufi Saints of Pakistan.

title: THE CONSULTATIVE MEETING OF THE PRO-VICE CHANCELLORS OF CAMPUSES, DEANS, DIRECTORS, CHAIRPERSONS AND INCHARGES HELD
html: THE CONSULTATIVE MEETING OF THE PRO-VICE CHANCELLORS OF CAMPUSES, DEANS, DIRECTORS, CHAIRPERSONS AND INCHARGES HELDA Consultative Meeting of the Pro-Vice Chancellors of Campuses, Deans of all faculties, Directors, Chairpersons and Incharges of all Teaching Institutes and Departments of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur was held. The Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto presided over the meeting.Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto cordially welcomed the all participants in the meeting. He said this consultative meeting on academic and research matters will promote the sense of responsibilities and academic culture at the campus. Dr. Ibupoto said I always firmly believe in collective wisdom and cooperation for the betterment of institution, better governance, transparency and merit. The Vice Chancellor obtained various suggestions and feedback for further improvement in the forth-coming session which will start from 17 January 2022.After detailed deliberations, various decisions were taken. It was decided that the meetings of the Board of Studies and Board of Faculties will be convened timely to take the decisions on various issues pertaining to academic, research and development. It was decided that the combined classes of subjects like Mathematics, Islamic Studies, English and Pakistan Studies will jointly be conducted where it is possible and feasible. In order to maintain the proper mechanism for the maintenance of students attendance is concerned, a committee was constituted on the Senior Professors along with the I.T Manager. It was decided that in line with the decision of the last meeting of the Syndicate that contract lecturers shall be appointed wherein, the terms of references and criteria will be sought from other reputable Universities. It was decided that one Expert from the Industry and other relevant profession will be opted on Board of Studies related with the market oriented Departments in order to make a strong liaison with Industry and Academia. It was decided that all the Faculty Members including .S and Teaching Assistants will perform their invigilation duties on the day of Pre-Entry Test on 11 January 2022. It was decided that during the winter vacations the results of Second Semester-2021 will be submitted to the Controller of Examinations Office. Meanwhile, timetable will also be prepared and notified during winter vacations. The Winter Vacations will commence from 03 January to 16 January 2022 while the classes of Academic Year 2022 for B.S Part-II, III, IV and V will start from 17 January 2022 at the main campus and its sub-campuses.The Pro-Vice Chancellors of Ghotki Campuse, Deans of Faculties, Directors, Chairpersons, Incharges and the Representatives of all Teaching Institutes and Departments attended the meeting.

title: THE INAUGURATION CEREMONY OF ENGAGING FACULTY MEMBERS, STUDENTS AND HOSTEL COMMUNITY WAS HELD AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KHAIRPUR.
html:
THE INAUGURATION CEREMONY OF ENGAGING FACULTY MEMBERS, STUDENTS AND HOSTEL COMMUNITY WAS HELD AT SHAH ABDUL LATIF UNIVERSITY KHAIRPUR.

The Inauguration ceremony of Engaging Faculty Members, Students and Hostel Community was held at Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur, in collaboration with Center for Health and Gender Equality (CHANGE) and Inter university consortium for the promotion of social sciences (IUCPSS).

Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto presided over the ceremony while Mr. Saifullah Abro Deputy Commissioner was the Chief Guest and Prof Dr. Madad Ali Shah Vice Chancellor Benazir Bhuttlo Shaheed University of Technology and Skill Development Khairpur was the guest of honor. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said we are committed to promote the essence of the peace and tolerance. Sindh is the land of Sufi saints whose message is human dignity and tolerance. It is high time to promote the sense of unity and we have to follow the path of peace. Dr Ibupoto said we have established the first ever students service society building funded by the USAID so in this building co circular activities will be promoted. Dr Ibupoto accorded special thanks to Executive Director (CHANGE) Mr. Mumtaz Hussain Kharal for his support to engage the faculty and stake holders for the promotion of peace narrative.

Mr. Saifullah Abro Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur said that the role of government is pivotal in the promotion of peace which starts from cradle to grave. State and Society are inter linked with each other. He said state institutions are responsible for peace narrative, social justice, National integration and social justice. Mr Abro remarked that we could contain the menace of terrorism with the peace narrative and efforts of youth. He stressed the students to take part in the competitive examinations to serve the nation and people at large.

Prof. Dr. Madad Ali Shah said that League of Nations and United Nations were established for the promotion of cause of peace. Through peace we could contain the conflicts in our society. Dr. Shah commended the efforts of Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for the capacity building of faculty, staff and students.

Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences and Focal person for (CHANGE) shed light on the objectives of the project aimed at to promote social harmony, diversity, acceptance and tolerance among the faculty members, students, hostel staff and administration. He said different mobilization seminars, trainings will be conducted.

Prof. Dr. Samina Rajper Director ORIC, Mr. Siraj Ahmed Soomro, Mr Ali Raza Lashari, Ms Shehbano also spoke on this occasion. They stressed the need to accept the diversity, cultural, linkages. They said the youth is an agent of change and with their help we could promote the peace narrative.

Mr. Mumtaz Hussain Kharal Executive Director Center for health and Gender Equality (CHANGE) accorded vote of thanks. He appreciated the efforts of Vice Chancellor, registrar and Dean Faculty of Social Sciences for providing a viable platform at the university. He said this project will promote the state peace narrative.

The proceedings for the ceremony were conducted by the Mr. Hassan Shaikh. The ceremony was attended by Muhammad Parvez Mushtaque (Director Programs CHANGE), Muhammad Hussain (Program Coordinator CHANGE) and a large number of teachers, students and staff attended the ceremony.

Director, Media & Public Relations

Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur

Dated: 08-02-2022

The Spokesperson of Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur has issued a Press Release regarding the vacating of Hostel Rooms at 200 Boys Hostels. The Spokesperson has maintained that some Ex-Students and Non-Allottees have unauthorizedly occupied 12 Rooms. As a result, the Hostel Administration with the help of District Police, vacated the occupied Rooms and University Authorities have lodged F.I. R against the occupants who resisted, threatened and harassed the Hostel Administration not to allot the occupied Rooms to the genuine students. Their such act is tantamounting as illegal and part of violation of Hostel Rules and Regulations. The Provost (Hostels) has started the allotment of Boys Hostels on the basis of distance, which is the criteria of merit. The Spokesperson has appreciated the proactive role of District Police and Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur for the vacating of 12 Rooms occupied by the miscreants.

The Spokesperson has appealed the genuine hostel residents and allotees to cooperate with the University Administration to maintain peace and tranquility within the premises of University, especially in the Hostels.

Spokesperson

Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur

Dated: 02-02-2022

title: THE THREE-DAY BLOOD DONATION CAMP ESTABLISHED AT SALU

THE THREE-DAY BLOOD DONATION CAMP ESTABLISHED AT SALU

A Three-day blood donation camp was inaugurated at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur jointly organized by the institute of Microbiology and Fatimid, thalassemia Khairpur.

Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto vice chancellor inaugurated Donation Camp.

While talking to the participants. He said in our society blood anemia is increasing day by day. The initiative taken by the Director Institute of Microbiology Prof. Dr. Zulfiqar Ali Malik is commendable since this is noble and humanitarian cause. He advised the staff and students to donate the blood at this camp.

Prof. Dr. Zulfiqar Ali Malik said, this camp will continue for three days at university to collect the blood for needy patients. He also accorded his special thanks to the vice chancellor who spared his precious time to inaugurate this camp. He also extended his thanks to the administration of the Fatimid Foundation, Khairpur for the establishment of this camp.

Syed Muslim Shah Administrator Fatimid, Mr. Ali Hassan Camp Coordinator and Mr. Muhammad Raheel lab Supervisor were facilitator and organizers of the camp.

Prof. Dr. Abdul Hussain Shar Dean faculty of Natural Sciences, Prof. Dr. Mushtaq Ahmed Jakhrani, Mr. Zuhaib Memon and large number of teachers, researchers and students attended the ceremony.

title: THREE-DAY INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON GOVERNANCE & QUALITY ASSURANCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTES CONCLUDED
html: THREE-DAY INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON GOVERNANCE & QUALITY ASSURANCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTES CONCLUDEDThree-Day International Conference on Governance & Quality Assurance in Higher Education Institutes concluded at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur jointly organized by the Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC), Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur in collaboration with Higher Education Commission, Pakistan, Pakistan Network of Quality Assurance in Higher Education (PNQAHE), Khyber Medical University, Peshawar and The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over the concluding session while Mr. Muhammad Mureed Rahmoon, Secretary, Universities & Boards Department, Govt. of Sindh was the chief guest. Prof. Dr. Sarosh Lodhi, Vice Chancellor, N.E.D University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi, Prof. Dr. Saleem Raza Samo, Vice Chancellor, Quaid-i-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology, Nawabshah, Mr. Saifullah Abro, Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur and Prof. Dr. Zia-ul-Haque, President, PNQAHE and Vice Chancellor Khyber Medical University Peshawar were the guests of honor.Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that there are five basis of quality assurance in Higher Education Institutes i.e. teachers, students, parents, society and government but there is direct relationship between the two segments teachers and students. We teachers are responsible for the promotion of quality. Dr. Ibupoto said during the course of conference, different suggestions and recommendations were given by the foreign and national scholars. These recommendations are value-added and will be sent to the concerned quarters for implementations. Dr. Ibupoto accorded especial thanks to Mr. Muhammad Mureed Rahmoon Secretary Universities & Boards who spared his precious time to grace the conference and also the guest Vice Chancellor of different Universities of Pakistan.Mr. Muhammad Mureed Rahmoon said that higher education is based on trainings, capacity building, but we must concentrate on the improvement of Primary Education because it is the baseline of the nation and students groom from the Primary Education. He said that government will support in the fields of research and development and projects on multilateral fields. He said that the huge responsibility lies to the Universities to equip the students with the knowledge. There is no need of bulk degrees but degrees with quality are essential for nation building. He assured that Universities and Boards Department will support Universities financially and administratively. He appreciated the dynamic efforts of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto and his team for organizing this international moot in befitting manner.Prof. Dr. Sarosh Lodhi said that quality is perception. It is limit less. Quality has benchmarks. Quality is gaining momentum day by day. Dr. Lodhi said quality is based on ethics and values. It is need of the time that better human resource may be produced with the help of quality education and research. He also extended felicitation to Prof. Dr. Iram Rani Director QEC, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur for organizing this result oriented conference.Renowned foreign and national scholars Dr. Anca Prisacariu from Romania, Dr. Bassam-Alhamad from Bahrain, Dr. Donald Staub, Dr. Bahar Gun from Turkey, Dr. Rukhsana Kaleem from Lahore, Prof. Dr. Minhoon Khan Laghari and Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Secretary of the conference also shared their views. They appreciated the hospitality extended by the host University.Prof. Dr. Asif Shaikh, Director, QEC, N.E.D University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi accorded vote of thanks.The concluding session was attended by the Deans, Directors, Chairpersons, Sectional Heads, Teachers and Students.

title: THREE-DAY INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON GOVERNANCE & QUALITY ASSURANCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTES INAUGURATED
html: THREE-DAY INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON GOVERNANCE & QUALITY ASSURANCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTES INAUGURATEDThree-Day International Conference on Governance & Quality Assurance in Higher Education Institutes inaugurated at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur jointly organized by the Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC), Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur in collaboration with Higher Education Commission, Pakistan, Pakistan Network of Quality Assurance in Higher Education (PNQAHE), Khyber Medical University, Peshawar and The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur presided over the inaugural session while Prof. Dr. Azam Ali Khuwaja, Former Managing Director, Higher Education Commission, Islamabad was the chief guest. Prof. Dr. Fateh Muhammad Mari, Ex-Executive Director, Higher Education Commission, Pakistan and incumbent Vice Chancellor, Sindh Agriculture University Tandojam, Prof. Dr. Amanat Ali Jalbani, Vice Chancellor, Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad and Prof. Dr. Zia-ul-Haque, President, PNQAHE and Vice Chancellor Khyber Medical University Peshawar were the guests of honor.Talking to the participants, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that the Higher Education Institutes (HEIs) are recognized with the quality assurance as result the governance and research input enhances. He said we have to adopt best practices in the field of research and innovation in order to adopt the new modules and models in the research. He stressed the need to embark the quality research with the help of collaborative research. Dr. Ibupoto extended cordial thanks to national and international delegates participated in this international moot. He also extended felicitation to Secretary of the Conference Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Director, QEC and Dr. Minhoon Khan Laghari and Organizing Committee.Prof. Dr. Azam Ali Khuwaja said there are more than 100 definitions in literature for quality. Quality lies in the public eyes. He said we have to define parameters for quality assurance. He said the crux of the quality assurance is to share best practices along with international best practices. Dr. Khuwaja said that the first University was established in the year 1297 in the name of Bologna in Italy as pioneer word University.Prof. Dr. Fateh Muhammad Mari said that the quality is a fundamental in higher education. It is ability to distinct. He said several issues are pertaining in the quality assurance as challenges but it is need of the time to address and focus on teachers’ qualification and ability, students capacity building and research and development. It is also imperative to concentrate on the commitment and delivery of teachers in the primary, secondary and tertiary education.Prof. Dr. Amanat Ali Jalbani said quality management is a vast subject. He quoted the example of early education of Sindh and Pakistan where the teachers possess the qualification of 7th class but he possesses the knowledge more than Masters Class degree. He said there are different factors which affected the quality of education and research i.e. qualification of teachers, governance, curriculum, market related subjects. When we are concentrating to improve the above areas, definitely the quality of product will be value-added for community and society. He said we have to improve our primary education because it is baseline of our nation.Prof. Dr. Zia-ul-Haque said that we are gathered here for the promotion of quality culture because we have to maintain the essence of quality in HEIs in the field of research and to remove the gray areas. He said we have witnessed the mushroom growth of establishment of Universities. Dr. Zia said PNQAHE is the independent body striving for quality assurance.Dr. Ayesha Bukhari, General Secretary, PNQAHE said that Higher Education Commission, Islamabad have taken initiatives for the establishment of Quality Enhancement Cells in Universities to share best practices. She said earlier, we started to establish the PNQAHE for quality research. She revealed that we have launched research journal in order to promote quality research culture on the platform of PNQAHE. She acknowledged the hospitality of host University and also extended the cordial thanks to Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto who is taking care of the delegates.Keynote Speaker Dr. Ancuta Prisacariu from Romania delivered her keynote speech on the topic “The Changing Role of the State within National Quality Assurance System”. She said it is the duty of the state to focus on quality research, exchange of scholarships. Governance in higher education institutions is imperative. We have to align our efforts for academic integrity. She said technology’s boom has developed integration with the nations. We have to adopt international practices for quality assurance.Prof. Dr. Iram Rani, Director QEC and Secretary of the Conference accorded vote of thanks to the national and international delegates, media persons and organizing committee. She said there is need of transformation of international quality criteria and competitive research, share scholarly work and collaborative efforts in order to attain the quality assurance and governance in the HEIs.Prof. Dr. Mir Muhammad Shah, Vice Chancellor Sukkur IBA University, Sukkur, Prof. Dr. Madad Ali Shah, Syed Nasir Shah, Director General, Quality Assurance Agency, Higher Education Commission, Islamabad, Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ibrahim Keerio, Principal Khairpur Agriculture Engineering College, Khairpur, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Prof. Dr. Mumtaz Junejo, Dean Faculty of Management Sciences, Prof. Dr. Minhoon Khan Laghari and large number of teachers, research scholars, civil society activists, students and media persons attended the inaugural session.

title: TWO-DAY TRAINING AWARENESS SESSION ON INCLUSIVE VOTER PARTICIPATION
html: TWO-DAY TRAINING AWARENESS SESSION ON INCLUSIVE VOTER PARTICIPATION A Two-Day Training Awareness Session on Inclusive Voter Participation was held at Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur organized by the Parliamentarian’s Commission for Human Rights, Islamabad and Office of the Research Innovation & Commercialization (ORIC). The inaugural session was held at Department of Public Administration. Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences was the chief guest of the first session.Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari said the free, fair and transparent election process will install a pro-people and democratic setup of government in any country. This awareness training will create the sense of voter participation of youth in the forth coming elections. Dr. Lashari appreciated the patronage of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto for organizing this awareness session on the very important theme. He also lauded the efforts of Parliamentarian’s Commission for Human Rights, Islamabad for organizing this activity at this campus to sensitize the youth to cast their vote because this program is purely for inclusive voter education.Prof. Dr. Samina Rajpar, Director, ORIC and organizer of the session shed light on the objectives of the training workshop. She said this training aimed at to educate the youth on voter importance, to train the participants on voting process and to provide the information about the constitutional and institutional responsibilities.Mr. Muhammad Mueez Shamsi, Advocate Sukkur, Advocate Ratan Kumar, Mr. Waseem Ahmed Shaikh, District Focal Person Parliamentarian’s Commission for Human Rights, Sukkur Chapter and Mr. Ramal Farooque trained the students about the polling process, election process. They also apprised the students about importance of voting rights and introduction of Election Commission of Pakistan.The concluding session was held in the Institute of Computer Science. Prof. Dr. Noor Ahmed Shaikh, Director, Institute of Computer Science was the chief guest.Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Noor Ahmed Shaikh said that elections are the part of the democratic process. It is need of the time to educate the youth as well as masses to cast their vote to strengthen the democratic process. He appreciated the tangible efforts of Director ORIC Dr. Samina Rajpar for conduct of two-day session on inclusive voter education.Mr. Waseem Ahmed Shaikh said that the purpose of the two-day training session on inclusive voter education was to brief the students about the definition of election, importance of voting, it process and right of the voter, voting registration process, types of elections. He appreciated the cooperation extended by the administration of University for holding the sessions.Mr. Ali Raza Lashari was the facilitator of the two-day training sessions. A large number of teachers and students attended the sessions.

title: TWO-DAY TRANING WORKSHOP ON CRITICAL READING AND WRITING CONCLUDED
html: A Two-Day Training Workshop on Critical Reading and Writing organized by the Bhittai Social Watch & Advocacy (BSWA), Khairpur, Friedrich Ebert Stiftung (FES), Pakistan in collaboration with Shah Abdul Latif University (SALU), Khairpur and Inter-University Consortium for the Promotion of Social Sciences (IUCPSS) concluded. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur and Dr. Jochen Hippler from FES Pakistan inaugurated the workshop. The students from members institutions of IUCPSS including Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad, Ripha University, Rawalpindi, Khuwaja Fareed University, Rahim Yar Khan, Benazir Bhutto Shaheed Women University, Peshawar, Mir Chakar Khan Rind University, Sibbi, Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science & Technology, Karachi and F.C College University, Lahore and host Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur participated in the workshop.Speaking on this occasion, Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that critical reading and writing reflects one’s intellectual vision on any subject. This workshop has provided an ample opportunity to students to produce an intellectual piece of writing. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has expanded in terms of infrastructure and quality education. We not only provide students with excellent educational opportunities but also groom their personalities.Dr. Jochen Hippler from FES remarked that the purpose of this academic activity was to engage students in research based activities and encourage them for academic writings.The Resource Persons of Training Workshop were Dr. Jochen Hippler and Dr. Fatima Kamali from Quaid-i-Azam University School of Politics and International Relations.The Concluding Ceremony of the Workshop was held. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor presided over the ceremony while Mr. Raja Tarqiue Hussain Chandio, Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur was the chief guest. Mr. Murtaza Noor, National Coordinator IUCPSS, Dr. Jochen Hippler and Mr. Mukhtiar Malik, Renowned Poet and Broadcaster were the guests of honor.Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said it is matter of high pleasure and rejoice for me to welcome the galaxy of future scholars. He said I am really proud of students of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur who authored a book Peace Now & Forever. It is a good piece of edition for Central Library as well as for the readers of the world. We are on the path of development since we have set dynamic and energetic team. Dr. Ibupoto commended the efforts of IUCPSS, BSWA, FES Pakistan and the team of the SALU for organizing this result oriented workshop. The Vice Chancellor also appreciated the keen interest of Deputy Commissioner, Khairpur in the academic dialogue.Mr. Raja Tarqiue Hussain Chandio said that the glimpses and the title of the book are excellent. He said I am optimistic that peace will stay forever. Sindh has accepted different cultures. This is the land of Sufi Saints so we are broad minded. Mr. Chandio appreciated the efforts of Dr. Khalil Ibupoto who is working hard day and night for the development of the University.Dr. Jochen Hippler extended thanks to teachers who guided the students to accomplish their research publication in the advent of COVID-19.Speaking on this occasion, Mr. Murtaza Noor highlighted the importance of effective engagements of students at University campuses through promoting values of peace, tolerance and co-existence. In this regard, first ever student societies centre has been established at SALU.Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts & Languages spoke as keynote speaker. He said that the books authored by the students reflect their vision and commitment with the education and research. We are proud that our students possess potential and curiosity for the academic pursuit.Dr. Taj Muhammad Lashari, Dean Faculty of Social Sciences, Mr. Mureed Hussain Ibupoto, Registrar, Mr. Mukhtiar Malik, Mr. Muhammad Ibrahim Khokhar, Mr. Hassan Shaikh, Niklas Joschua Kemper FES, Pakistan, Syed Kaneez Zehra Rashdi, Mr. Abdullah Phulpoto, Mr. Muhammad Ali Lashari and Mr. Khadim Hussain Mirani also spoke on this occasion.Mr. Abdullah Dayo, Program Manager, FES Pakistan moderated the session.Meanwhile, launching of YouTube Channel “The Campus Life in Pakistan was also held. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto and Mr. Raja Tarqiue Hussain Chandio launched the YouTube channel. The screening of video documentary produced by the students of University was also telecasted. Certificates, Shields and Traditional Gifts were presented to the participants and guests. The ceremony was followed by Sufi Music performed by the Sufi Singers of the Sachal Sarmast Shrine. A large number of Civil Society Activists, Faculty Members and Social Activists attended the ceremony.

title: TWO MORE PH.D OPEN DEFENSE SEMINARS HELD IN THE DEPARTMENT OF SINDHI
html: Two Ph. D Open Defense Seminars were held in the Department of Sindhi, Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur presided over by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto. Research Scholar Mr. Abdul Latif Ansari delivered his Ph. D on the topic “A Critical and Research Analysis of Literary Contribution of Rasheed Bhatti” under the supervision of Prof (Retd.) Dr. Adal Soomro. Mr. Abdul Latif Ansari said that role of Late Rasheed Bhatti in literary criticism in Sindhi Language is very important, he gave inputs to the contemporary original thoughts through his creative literally criticism. He provided first hand information related to many persons and personalities including laywars, writers, politicians and social workers. As writer Rasheed Bhatti was a towering personality. The second Ph. D Seminar was delivered by Ms. Aisha Hassan Dharejo on the topic “Research and Critical Analysis of Women Problems in Sindhi Short Stories” under the supervision of Prof (Retd.) Dr. Adal Soomro. She said that literature is the soul of human life. In the beginning of 20th century, short stories were refined by the prominent writers Mal Persoram, Amar Lal Hingorjani, Mirza Qaleech Baig and others. I have assessed the political, social and economic status of society. The traditions and sufism, federalism and capitalism have been reviewed. My research work has also highlighted the past and present periods short stories for Women’s problem whereas injustices are committed with the women have been analyzed in my research work.While delivering his presidential address the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto said that literature is an integral part of the society which reflects the culture, civilization, arts, music, calligraphy. Late Rasheed Bhatti was a man of letter, he contributed lot in the promotion of Sindhi literature. He contributed in the writing of fiction, columns, his literary services will be remembered for long period.Dr. Ibupoto said that research work of the Ms. Aisha Hassan Dharejo is up to the mark. She has shed light on the problems of women in Sindhi Short Stories. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that the work of both scholars will be value added in the Sindhi literature. We are committed to provide a viable platform for embarking research at campus.Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts and Languages said that we are promoting the research culture in the Faculty of Arts and Languages on modern yardstick and parameters and encouraging the scholars to complete their research work within their stipulated time.Prof. (Retd.) Dr. Adal Soomro, Dr. Anwar Figar Hakro and Dr. Inayat Laghari also spoke on this occasion and appreciated the work of the research scholars. They said the Sindhi literature is rich historically. The contribution of both Scholars will be positive addition in the Sindhi literature.Both Open Defense Seminars were declared as successful. Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Director Postgraduate Studies conducted the proceedings of the Seminars.A large number of teachers, research scholars and students attended the Seminars.

title: TWO PH. D OPEN DEFENSE SEMINARS HELD IN THE DEPARTMENT OF SINDHI
html: Two Ph. D Open Defense Seminars were held in the Department of Sindhi, Shah Abdul Latif University Khairpur presided over by the Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto.Research Scholar Mr. Ibrahim Kharal defended his Ph. D research on the topic “Critical Analysis of Naseem Kharal’s Stories under the supervision of Prof. (Retd.) Dr. Adal Soomro. Mr. Ibrahim Kharal said that Naseem Kharal was the prominent writer of Sindhi prose and story. He was a renowned Sindhi story writer, he has portrayed the real Sindhi society and written short stories on the indigenous characters. In his stories he has pinpointed the various negative traditions prevailing at that time i.e Honor Killing and Exploitation based Society. The second Ph. D Open Defense Seminar was delivered by Mr. Ateequllah Memon under the supervision of Prof Dr. Adal Soomro on the topic ” Status of Sindhi Language during the British Rule”. He said Sindhi is an ancient language which flourished in the British Rule. The Sindhi Language reached at the highest zenith. The British Rulers collected Sindhi diction, they focused on research, wrote books and published them. There is an impact of English Language on Sindhi. British era also exhibits that the British Rulers patronized Sindhi script, literature, poetry and language. Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor in his presidential address said that Ph. D research work is the outcome of indepth research work carried out by the Scholars either in Science or Arts because it is a novel work based on the ideas and innovation of scholarly work. Dr. Ibupoto remarked that research work of both scholars will be benefited in the field of Sindhi language and literature. He also appreciated the untiring efforts of Research Supervisor, Dean Faculty of Arts and Languages in the promotion of research culture.Prof. Dr. Ghulam Mustafa Mashori, Dean Faculty of Arts and Languages said that the both Scholars have delivered public defense inline with the HEC’s minimum eligibility criteria. The work of scholars will be value added for the future scholars. Prof. (Retd.) Dr. Adal Soomro, Dr. Ishaque Samejo, Dr. Anwar Figar Hakro, Dr. Bashir Fayaz Chandio appreciated the research work of the both Scholars. They said research activities are essential and positive activities at the Campus in order to embark the research. They also commended the keen interest of Vice Chancellor in the development of research and innovation at University. Despite hectic engagement, he remained present in the Seminars and presided the Open Defense.The Open Defense Seminars were declared as successful. Dr. Naveed Ahmed Shaikh, Director Postgraduate Studies conducted the proceedings of the Seminars.A large number of teachers, research scholars and students attended the Seminars.

Dr. Agha Nadia presented her authored book to Consul General.

title: VICE CHANCELLOR VISITS THE ONGOING CLASSES OF SECOND SEMESTER-2022
html: VICE CHANCELLOR VISITS THE ONGOING CLASSES OF SECOND SEMESTER-2022Prof. Dr. Khalil Ahmed Ibupoto, Vice Chancellor, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur paid a visit of ongoing Classes of Second Semester-2022 after resumption of academic activities at the Campus. Dr. Ibupoto visited the various Institutes and Departments along with Deans of Faculties, Directors, Chairperson of Institutes and Departments and Advisor for Academics. During the visit, the Vice Chancellor interacted with Faculty Members and Students and checked the attendance of the Faculty Members.The Vice Chancellor stressed the Faculty Members to take their classes with the spirit of regularity and punctuality so the academic gap during the havoc of monsoon rains could be covered. He also directed the students to maintain their regularity and punctuality in their classes so they could pursue higher education from this prestigious Institution. Dr. Ibupoto felt his entire satisfaction over the arrangements made for the smooth conduct of classes.

شاھ عبداللطيف يونيورسٽي خيرپور جي ترجمان پاران وضاحتي بيان جاري ڪندي ٺري ميرواهه لڳ ميھر ويسر بس اسٽاپ تي ٺري ميرواهه لاءِ مخصوص يونيورسٽي پوائنٽ بس تي حملي جي سخت لفظن ۾ مذمت ڪئي آهي. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آهي ته يونيورسٽي انتظاميه متاثر شاگردن جي شڪايت تي ٺري ميرواهه پوليس اسٽيشن ڏانهن جھيڙي ۾ ملوث شاگردن ۽ آئوٽ سائيڊرن خلاف ايف آئي آر درج ڪرڻ لاءِ ليٽر روانو ڪيو ھو. ان سلسلي ۾ چند فرد گرفتار ٿي چڪا آهن. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آهي ته جھيڙي ۾ ملوث شاگردن خلاف يونيورسٽي جي قائدن ۽ ضابطن تحت ڊسپلنري ڪاميٽي ذريعي سخت قدم کنيا ويندا. ان سلسلي ۾ ترجمان ٻنھي شاگرد ڌرين کي اپيل ڪئي آهي ته ھو قانون جي دائري ۾ رھن ۽ امن ۽ امان جو مسئلو پيدا نه ڪن. ھو تدريسي عمل ۾ شرڪت ڪن ۽ ننڍن ننڍن مسئلن تي جھيڙن کان باز رھن جيڪڏهن کين ڪنھن به شاگرد ڌر يا فرد جي خلاف ڪا به شڪايت آھي ته ھو سڌو سنئون يونيورسٽي جي اسٽوڊنٽ ايڊوائز جي آفيس وٽ پنھنجي شڪايت درج ڪرائين ۽ قانون جي خلاف ورزي نه ڪن.

title: پريس رليز
html:
خيرپور

پريس رليز

شاهه عبداللطيف يونيورسٽي خيرپور جي ترجمان پاران جاري ڪيل پريس رليز ۾ شاهه عبداللطيف يونيورسٽي ايمپلائيز ويلفيئر ايسوسيئيشن جي عهديدارن پاران مطالبن جي سلسلي ۾ هڙتال کي غير مناسب رويو قرار ڏنو آهي. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آهي ته وائيس چانسلر پروفيسر ڊاڪٽر خليل احمد ابوپوٽو جي ھدايت تحت ڊيپارٽمينٽل پروموشن ڪاميٽي ۾ 104 مختلف گريڊز ۾ ملازمن کي ترقي ڏني وئي آهي جڏهن ته ايڇ آر رويو ڪاميٽي جو اجلاس گھرائي ملازمن جي مختلف پوسٽن کي اپگريڊ ڪيو ويو آهي. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آهي ته ريٽارئرڊ ملازمن جي اولاد جي ڪوٽا تحت نوڪري ۾ رکڻ لاء اسم سينڊيڪيٽ جي ايندڙ اجلاس جي ايجنڊا ۾ رکيو ويو آهي ان کان علاوه ھر ملازم کي ڇھ مھينا ريٽائرمنٽ کان اڳ ۾ ھڪ گريڊ ۾ ترقي ڏني ويندي. تازو 16 ملازمن جي ميڊيڪل جي بلن جي ادائگي جا ڪيس ميڊيڪل ايڊوائزري ڪاميٽي مان منظور ڪرايا ويا آهن. ان کان علاوه ڪلارڪن کي ڪمپيوٽر آپريٽر طور ترقي ڏيڻ لاءِ ھڪ ٽيسٽ ڪاميٽي پڻ تشڪيل ڏني وئي آهي. ملازمن جي ٽيڪنيڪل پاليسي تحت ترقي جا ڪيس ايندڙ سينڊيڪيٽ جي اجلاس ۾ اسم طور رکيا ويا آهن. سينئر بس ڪنڊڪٽر/ڪلينرز کي سندن فني ڄاڻ جي بنياد تي ڊرائيورز طور ترقي ڏيڻ لاءِ منظوري ڏني وئي آهي. ترجمان واضح ڪيو آهي ته ايمپلائيز ويلفيئر ايسوسيئيشن جي جنرل سيڪريٽري جي وائيس چانسلر سان ملاقات ٿي هئي جنھن ۾ ايڇ آر رويو ڪاميٽي جي ڪنوينر پڻ موجود ھئي ۽ انھن مذڪورہ حل ٿيل مسئلن جي روشنيءَ ۾ ايمپلائيز ويلفيئر ايسوسيئيشن جي جنرل سيڪريٽري وائيس چانسلر کي خاطري ڪرائي هئي ته ايسوسيئيشن ھڙتال نه ڪندي پر ھنن ان عمل جي خاطري بعد خلاف ورزي ڪئي آهي جيڪو پڻ غير معقول، نامناسب ۽ ناجائز رويي جي عڪاسي ڪري ٿو. ترجمان ايسوسيئيشن جي عهديدارن کي گذارش ڪئي آھي ته ھو مقدس تدريسي اداري ۽ انتظاميه جو ساٿ ڏين ته جيئن ھي ادارو پنھنجي اعلي درجي تي علم جي روشني ڦهلائي. ياد رهي ته 19 مھينن کان جڏھن موجوده وائيس چانسلر يونيورسٽي جو انتظامي منصب سنڀاليو آھي ته سڀني استادن، آفيسرن ۽ ملازمن کي پگهار، پينشن ۽ ان کان علاوه ليو انڪيشمنٽ جي ادائيگي پڻ وقت سر ٿي آھي ۽ محدود مالي وسيلن ۽ مالي شفافيت سبب ڪافي بلن جي ادائگي ٿي چڪي آهي. ھوڏانھن ترجمان ڄاڻايو آهي ته آفيسرز ويلفيئر ايسوسيئيشن يونيورسٽي جي انتظاميه پاران تشڪيل ڏنل ڪاميٽي سان ڪامياب ڳالهين ۽ جائز مسئلن جي حل بعد ھڙتال ختم ڪرڻ جو اعلان ڪيو آهي.

شاهه عبداللطيف يونيورسٽي خيرپور جي ترجمان شاهه عبداللطيف يونيورسٽي ٽيچرز ايسوسيئيشن (سلوٽا) جي عھديدارن پاران جاري ڪيل پريس بيان جي سلسلي ۾ وضاحت ڪندي ڄاڻايو آھي تہ يونيورسٽي جي وائيس چانسلر پروفيسر ڊاڪٽر خليل احمد ابوپوٽو پاران سڀني فيڪلٽين جي ڊينز، ڊائريڪٽر ڪوالٽي انھانسمنٽ سيل ۽ ڊائريڪٽر اورڪ جي مشتمل اسڪروٽني ڪاميٽي تشڪيل ڏني وئي ھئي جيڪا استادن جي ترقين جي لاءِ سندن ڪيسز جي جاچ پڙتال مسلسل ٽن مھينن کان ڪري رھي ھئي اسڪروٽني ڪاميٽي شروعاتي طور تي يونيورسٽي پاران مقرر ٿيل معيار مطابق ڏنل اشتھار مطابق جاچ پڙتال ڪئي جنھن جي نتيجي ۾ معيار تي پورو نہ لھندڙ (Not Eligible) اميدوارن کي خط جاري ڪيا ويا آھن. اسڪروٽني ڪاميٽي جو اجلاس جنھن جي صدارت وائيس چانسلر ڪندو جيڪو سڀاڻي 17 ۽ 18 فيبروي 2022 تي ذاتي ٻڌڻي (Personal Hearing) ٿيندي. انتظاميہ معيار تي پورو نہ لھندڙ اميدوارن ۽ استادن کي پنھنجو موقف ڏيڻ لاءِ قانوني رستو اختيار ڪيو آھي تہ ھو پنھنجو پاڻ کي اھل ثابت ڪرڻ لاءِ مواد فراھم ڪن ۽ پنھنجي ڪيس کي سھڻي نموني سان ڪاميٽي آڏو دفاع ڪن. . ترجمان واضح ڪيو آھي تہ سلوٽا جي ايگزيڪيوٽو ڪائونسل جو اجلاس وائيس چانسلر سان گذريل ھفتي ٿي گذريو جنھن ۾ ھنن انتظامي بلاڪ آڏو احتجاج نہ ڪرڻ جي يقين دھاني ڪرائي ھئي پر افسوس سان چوڻو ٿو پئي تہ سلوٽا جي عھديدارن ڪامياب ڳالھين بعد خلاف ورزي ڪئي آھي ۽ ھنن ڌڙڻو جاري رکيو آھي. ترجمان سلوٽا پاران جاري ڪيل بيانن جي زبان تي پڻ انتھائي افسوس جو اظھار ڪيو آھي تہ معزز پروفيسرن کي اھڙي زبان استعمال ڪرڻ مناسب ناھي ھنن مذاڪراتي ڪاميٽي خلاف گٿا لفظ استعمال ڪيا آھن جيڪو پڻ نامعقول عمل آھي. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آھي تہ وائيس چانسلر ۽ اسڪروٽني ڪاميٽي مڪمل شفافيت ۽ شراڪت داري تي يقين رکي ٿي ۽ ڪنھن بہ استاد کي نقصان نہ پھچايو ويندو ۽ انصاف ۽ قانون جون گهرجون پوريون ڪيون وينديون. ترجمان ڄاڻايو آھي تہ انتظاميہ پاران سلوٽا جي ڪنھن بہ عھديدار خلاف نازيبا زبان جو استعمال نہ ڪيو ويو آھي ۽ ترجمان ان تاثر کي سختي سان رد ڪيو آھي. ترجمان استاد برادري کي اپيل ڪئي آھي تہ ھو احتجاج جو رستو ترڪ ڪن ۽ پنھنجون تدريسي ذميداريون احسن طريقي سان سرانجام ڏين جيڪو سندن قومي فرض ۾ شامل آھي.

Knowledge based economy is the most important pillar for a nation’s growth and height. In view of the importance of knowledge based economy, Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur originated Directorate of Research, i.e., OFFICE OF RESEARCH, INNOVATION AND COMMERCIALIZATION in 1994. The main purpose of this Directorate is to encourage the members of academic staff to promote research activities within the University, to advise and help in planning and preparing research projects, to provide facilities for the running projects, to recommend financial aids for new projects on the advise of the Research Committee.

The Directorate is always in contact with various local and overseas funding agencies to get research grants for projects of national interests. It also tries to develop collaboration with various research organizations so as to establish joint research projects. Apart from that it organizes research seminar lectures of research fellows working for M.Phil and Ph.D degrees as well as invites eminent scholars to give lectures.

Capacity Building

The ORIC, SALU, Khairpur is striving continuously to provide trainings for capacity building of faculty and students. Various Trainings/workshops/Seminars has been organized time to time within main Campus and other campuses also.

Dr. Abdul Sami Shaikh
Chairman
asami.shaikh@salu.edu.pk

INTRODUCTION
The Department is offering a five-year Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D) Program, which is recognized by the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan and is accredited by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan. It was established in 2010 and holds a significant position. It is the first ever national level-public sector institute of pharmaceutical sciences in the Upper Sindh with a proclaimed objective of becoming a center of excellence for advanced studies and research in all fields of pharmaceutical sciences, including the clinical aspect of the profession. The Pharmacy Program prides itself in developing highly qualified independent practitioners able to provide patient-centered care in various environments. After completing this program, pharmacists will be capable of conducting their practice with a high level of maturity and leadership and be able to perform practice-related projects.

VISION
To be recognized nationally and internationally as a leader in Pharmacy education and research that focuses on appropriate use of and access to pharmaceuticals and medical devices, as well as cost-effective provision and delivery of pharmaceutical care.

MISSION
To prepare pharmacists to provide optimal pharmaceutical care, and to prepare graduate and postgraduate students for
leadership in teaching, research, practice and service. The Department faculty generates and disseminates knowledge
to promote safe, clinically effective, and cost-efficient use of medications.

INTRODUCTION
The department was established as “Department of Physical Education” in 2019 as no master degree awarding institute was present in interior Sindh and as a first step, a Master’s degree program “Master of Physical Education” (M.P.Ed) two year degree program was introduced. The first batch of this degree program was admitted in 2019. Master in physical education two year degree program was introduced to provide skilled manpower in the field of Physical Education to cater the growing demand in secondary schools, colleges, universities and other national organizations. The department is equipped with required infrastructure of learning in the field of physical education including sports complex having indoor hall for badminton, table tennis, basketball, volleyball and ground for cricket and athletics. In addition, a fitness Centre is also available for fitness exercises for students, employees and officers in both morning and evening timings. This department will be flourishing day by day and would get recognition all over Pakistan when its students will attempt competitive examinations and in the job market of all Provinces and Federal Government. The department possesses a qualified and experienced faculty who are disseminating knowledge, skills and experience to their students.

VISION
The department of Physical Education envisions providing skilled candidates to meet the needs of Physical education in the each and every environment where it exists.

MISSION
The department of Physical education is committed to produce trained graduates with all skills to seek meaningful opportunities in the field of Physical education and sports.

The Department of Political Science is the guiding light for the future of the coming generations of our beloved homeland and the international society. Political Science intends for creating peaceful paths- moral and justified laws and theories- that help human being to run society in harmonious environment.

The faculty members of the department are committed rigorously to advance new knowledge, philosophy through introducing new subjects, like human rights, good governance and global politics.

As a Department, we are embarking on a new and exciting phase of the development, the ever-increasing intellectual exchange between our staff and students; between our scholars, the foreign and the guest intellectuals. title: Procedure & Eligibility Criteria
html:
Procedure & Eligibility Criteria

  1. Every candidate desirous of taking admission to the Graduate (BS Four-Year Program) or post- graduate classes shall fill in the online admission form available at official website of the Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur (www.salu.edu.pk). The interested candidates are directed to upload all the necessary documents alongwith of Rs. 1500/- deposited at designate HBL branches as admission form processing fee.
  2. Every candidate shall supply three copies of his/her recent photograph (two passport size and one (1’x 1. ½”), duly attested, along with the admission form.
  3. Anyone who has passed the H.S.C Part- II Intermediate Examination or any other examination recognized by the University as equivalent to the H.S.C Part- II Intermediate Examination annual/Supplementary 2016 to 2019 and annual 2020 is eligible to seek admission to the relevant (Graduate) (4 Year Program) course provided that he/she fulfills the requirements of minimum percentage of 50% marks for Arts /Commerce Students and other conditions of admission as may be prescribed from time-to-time. For admission in Department of Pharmacy, the candidate should have obtained minimum 60% marks (B Grade) in Intermediate/HSC-(Biology group).
  4. A candidate who has passed H.S.C Part- II Commerce Examination is also eligible for admission to BS program except Natural and Physical Science faculties.
  5. A candidate who has already completed Bachelor’s pass Degree is not eligible for admission to BS course in any discipline.
  6. Anyone who has passed the Bachelor’s examinations from this or any other recognized University shall be eligible to seek admission to the Master’s Program provided that he/she fulfills the requirement of minimum of marks and other conditions of admissions as may be prescribed.
  7. A candidate who has passed B.Sc. Annual/Semester examination 2015 to 2019 with a minimum of 50% marks shall be eligible for seeking admission to M.Sc. (Previous). A candidate who has passed B.Sc./B.A/ B.Com (Pass) examination with minimum of 50% marks shall be eligible for seeking admission to M.A/M.Com/MPA(Previous) A candidate who has passed B.Com (Pass) examination with a minimum of 50% marks shall be eligible for seeking admission to M.Com (Previous).
  8. A candidate having completed their regular scheme of study in BS/M.A/M.Com/MPA/MBA or any other 16 Year regular programs shall not be eligible for admission in 16 years program.
  9. Those students who have 16 years Business education are eligible to apply for MBA 1.5year program.
  10. A candidate who desires to take admission in the University be a national of Pakistan. The foreigners may be considered for admission only when nominated/recommended by the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance & Economic Affairs Division, Government of Pakistan.
  11. The candidate shall have to produce the following documents in original along with their attested Photostat copies:

    1. Pass/Marks Certificate of the last Qualifying Examination;
    2. Transfer Certificate from Principal of the College /Institute last attended;
    3. Character Certificate from Principal of the College /Institute last attended.
  12. A candidate who has passed examination from other university & from any board other than the Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Sukkur & Larkana shall not be admitted to any class unless he/she obtains a certificate of eligibility from Shah Abdul Latif University, However, the Registrar may issue a provisional admission certificate if he is satisfied that the applicant is prima facie eligible for admission in the University on the condition that he/she obtains a final certificate of eligibility before such date as may be fixed by the Vice Chancellor.
  13. Vice Chancellor may refuse admission to any candidate without mentioning any reason.
  14. All the admissions shall be provisional until approved by the Vice Chancellor.
  15. A student of the University admitted to any discipline as a regular student shall not appear in any examination as an external candidate during his/her University studentship.
  16. No change of department shall be allowed once the admission is taken.
  17. A student shall do all the necessary written work, tutorial and seminars as directed by his/her teachers to his /her /their satisfaction.
  18. A student shall do nothing, either in or outside the University that may interfere with the orderly administration and discipline or may bring the University and its administration into disrepute.
  19. The admission of student shall stand cancelled automatically if he/she occupies the University hostel or any other part forcibly or illegally.
  20. The University authorities shall not be responsible for providing transport facility to the students.
  21. The regular student is required to maintain at least 75% of attendance as eligibility to appear in the examination.
  22. No student shall be re-admitted without the prior permission of the Vice Chancellor, in case his/her admission is cancelled due to any reason.
  23. No ex-student shall be given access to the facilities of using the library, laboratories, seminars, etc. without the prior permission of the Vice Chancellor.
  24. Each student admitted to a four-year program or post-graduate class shall obtain identity card on the prescribed form on payment of the prescribed fee.
  25. If identity card is lost or destroyed, a duplicate must be obtained immediately at the payment of Rs.300/=
  26. Any student who is enrolled in the evening program will not be allowed to transfer to the morning program
  27. Refund of fees as per HEC criteria given bellow:

INTRODUCTION

Department of Public Administration was established in 2003. It offers BS (4 Years) and MPA (2 Years) Degree Programs; it provides professional education to the graduates for preparing them to seek their career through public service commission in different public sector organizations of Pakistan. Besides, they are going to be trained for non government organizations, private sector, businesses and all other types of national & multinational organizations. Entire academia of the department is well equipped with professional knowledge about organizational structure. The degree program has been designed to provide students with an understanding of the theories of organization, with particular reference to complex systems and seeking for operational solutions to the problems; management technologies including the use of sophisticated information system for the maintenance of ongoing organizational decisions. Students also have an opportunity to acquire specialized knowledge in areas such Human Resources Management, Marketing, Finance, Public Health Administration, Education Administration, E-Governance and Public Policy.

The degree program of BS (4 Years) is consisted of Eight (8) Semesters whereas;
MPA (2Years) is comprised of four (4) semesters. In this regard, candidates will be awarded degrees by completing the
departmental criteria.

VISION
To be a change agent to develop and enhance Public leadership through knowledge and quality education. The
Department of Public Administration is uniquely placed to prepare current and emergent leaders in local, regional,
national and global communities.

MISSION
Department is dedicated to prepare individuals for public services by keeping in view, ethics, norms, competency and
policy. We are seeking to improve them by facilitating learning through community engagement scholarship and
encouraged reflection as to work with leaders, managers and administrators representing diverse communities across all
domains of public service.

PROGRAMS OFFERED

  1. BS (Four-Year) (Morning & Evening)
  2. MPA (Two-Year) (Morning & Evening)
  3. MPhil
  4. PhD

The Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC) of Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur is determined to improve the quality of education in the University through implementing standards of Quality Assurance Agency, Higher Education Commission Pakistan. Online feedback on different surveys (Teachers, Students, Course Evaluation, Research Student Progress Review form including Faculty resume), not only reduced the time spent for data collection, analysis, and report generation but also minimized finance and labor.

Mr. Muhammad Hassan Shaikh
Director
Rozay Dhani (R.A) Chair

The “Rozey Dhani Chair” was established in 2005 the first phase of the building of Chair has been completed and handed-over on 27th January 2010 to Research Officer/Incharge Rozey Dhani Chair.

Brief History of Pir Sayed Muhammad Rashid “Rozey Dhani”

Pir Sayed Muhammad Rashid properly known as “Rozey Dhani” was born on 6th Ramzan 1170 A.D. and died on 1st Shahban 1233 A.D. (1757 – 1818) a spiritual leader and he is founder of “Rashdi Institute” at Pir-Jo-Goth, District Khairpur in the vicinity of this University. His scholarly contribution is universal in nature and practical guidance for humanity, in Modem Scientific Society and will surely save it from the fast approaching disaster, if read, understood and preached properly.

Pir Sayed Muhammad Rashid is very much honored and respected among the community of spiritual guides on account of his “Malfoozat” (Sayings) which are full of wisdom and spiritual guidance. It is the expression and feeling of a high religious scholar which provided the solution of the problems of our society. The main solution was enchanting of the diversity and duality. Though, he was a spiritual leader but maintained human and social relations throughout his life.

He spent his 35 precious years in preaching of Islam, and Silsila, Qadria, Rashdia School of thought. His famous book is (JAMA- UL-JAWAMIO) consisting three thousand pages are of considerable interest, based upon religion and theology.

His 46 letters written in reply to various literary and spiritual personalities on the theme of divine union mysticism and other aspects of life inviting the attention of Researchers, Scholars & People of every walk of life. Pir Muhammad Rashid made no less contribution to reveal the secrets of human life proceeding towards the path of truth.

title: SALU Software Technology Park
html:
Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) is an apex Government body mandated to promote Pakistan’s IT Industry in local and international markets. PSEB facilitates the IT industry through a series of projects and programs in infrastructure development, human capital development, company capability development, international marketing, strategy and research, and the promotion of innovation and technologies.

Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur has attained support of PSEB to establish a SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY PARK (STP)at the largest public university of upper Sindh. SALU has allocated a space of 5000sqft for establishment of this STP.

The Collaboration between SALU and PSEB will result, i.e.

  1. CAPACITY-BUILDING OF IT COMPANIES
  2. PSEB and SALU would work together to enhance academia – IT industry linkages so that both academia and IT industry can better understand reciprocal needs.

  1. Facilitation desk will be set up at SALU for the purpose of facilitating students, freelancers, start-

ups and entrepreneurs. Facilitation desk shall be managed by SALU and facilitated by PSEB.

  1. PSEB will assist SALU in technology training modules and language courses to train IT students

in emerging technologies, and build up a critical mass of qualified manpower to support and

sustain the development of IT industry.

  1. PSEB will work with SALU to increase the academia and industry linkages for better

understanding of each other’s needs.

  1. TECHNOLOGY CITIES & SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY PARK (STPs)

  1. SALU will provide specific area for establishment of Software Technology Parks (STPs) located

at Khairpur and other areas where they have presence for IT businesses, start-ups and freelancers.

Establishment of infrastructure and future development to be Mutually agreed by both parties.

  1. The tenants of the said Software Technology Parks (STPs) will be technology and/or software

companies, business process outsourcing companies, call centers and IT start-ups.

  1. PSEB will provide internet bandwidth to the Software Technology Parks (STPs) as per

requirements of the tenants.

  1. PSEB being facilitator of IT Industry shall market and extend all possible support to start-ups,

freelancers and IT graduates in populating the software technology parks.

  1. ACAMEDIA/INDUSTRY COLLOBRATION

  1. PSEB will make all efforts to create business matchups for the freelancers, start-ups and/or IT

Companies of SALU students, alumni and/or teachers and affiliates with international companies

through Pakistan’s counsellor generals and trade counsellors abroad.

title: Semester Rules & Regulations
html:
SEMESTER RULES & REGULATIONS

FACULTY OF ARTS & LANGUAGES (APPLICABLE FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR 2017 AND ONWARDS)

New semester rules shall be applicable for all students enrolling for BS (Part-I) and M.A (Previous) degree programs offered by the Faculty of Arts & Languages from academic year 2017 and onwards.

Grading Policy

G.P.A: The Grade Point Average (GPA) and Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of each student shall be determined as under:

(i) G.P.A. Total GP of courses per semester

Per Semester = Total No. of courses per semester

(ii) G.P.A G.P.A of Two semesters

Academic Year = 2

(iii) C.G.P.A = G.P.A of n Academic Years/Number of Yours

  • In case of allowing probation in a course, and promotion in the next semester to a student, if the second fraction after decimal is 5 or more, it will be taken into account by raising the first fraction to the next higher digit that will be as G.P.A 0.95 or 0.96 can be raised to 1.0.
  • In case of allowing probation in a course, and promotion in the next semester to a student, if the second fraction after decimal is 5 or more, it will be taken into account by raising the first fraction to the next higher digit that will be as G.P.A 0.95 or 0.96 can be raised to 1.0.
  • No “make up” exam is allowed in any course under any circumstance.

Grading Point (GP)

1. Probation:
A student who is fail in any course shall be allowed probation to pass the course. No semester break will be allowed to the probationers.

  • A student failing to obtain a minimum G.P.A of 2.0 in any semester will be placed on probation provided he/she shall not be fail in more than three courses and his/her G.P.A not less than 1.33.
  • Two consecutive probations are permissible in each course to pass or to maintain GPA of 2.0.
  • A student who is fail in four courses in any semester or did not maintain G.P.A 1.33 in a semester or
    did not maintain continuity in appearing in the Examinations but avail semester break he/ she shall
    be placed on term back from the rolls of the Department. A student accumulating three consecutive
    probations shall cease to be the student of the University.
  • A student failing to maintain GPA of 2.0 or fail in any course but maintaining GPA 2.0, shall be Letters Value Numerical Marks Grade Point A 87-100 4.0 B 72-86 3 to 3.9 C 60-71 2 to 2.9 F Below-60 0 47 placed on probation and he/she shall be promoted to next semester provided his/her GPA is not less than 1.33.
  • A student placed on probation shall repeat all the courses in which he/ she is fail and or such other courses as recommended by the department as soon as the course (s) are offered next semester
  • A student who is fail in four courses in any semester or could not maintain G.P.A 1.33 in a semester or could not maintain continuity in appearing in the Examinations but avail semester break he/ she shall be dropped from the rolls of the Faculty of Arts & Languages Main campus.

Restoration of Admission:

  • Student achieving less than GPA 1.33 and declared “drop” in any semester, may be provided with one chance to repeat the same semester in order to improve GPA up to or more than 1.33, till that he/she will not promoted in the next semester for which he/she has to submit a fresh application for restoration of admission and to pay full fees of the academic year.

Improvement of Grade ‘C’:
A student whose Degree in Grade C or a student shall be allowed to improve his/her grade C in the course (s) in any semester.
The marks distribution for probationer/failure/improver student is as under:

Course Marks Break-up

  • Each credit course carries 100 marks of which 50 marks are reserved for mid Term, attendance & assignment marks and awarded by teacher during the conduct of classes and the remaining 50 marks are for the Final Test Examination.
  • Minimum pass marks in each course are 60%.
  • The break-up of marks of each course is as under:

ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENT The class attendance requirement, for each student shall be 75 percent in each course to become eligible for appearing in the Mid Term & Final Test Examinations.

SHORT ATTENDANCE & RESTORATION OF ADMISSION IN SEMESTER
A student who fails short attendance in any case will not be eligible to appear in Mid Term or final test examination. That student case shall be examined by the chairman, or medical ground, if genuine, he /she will be recommended for the restoration of admission to continue education from that semester from where he/she discontinued education.

FEED BACK SYSTEM AND ASSESSMENT OF SCRIPTS
In semester system, the Teacher shall return the scripts of Mid Term Test after assessment of the test within a week to the student for feedback.

PAPER REVIEW DAY
Teacher will fix a “Paper Review Day” for students within twelve days after conduct of the final test paper to discuss the result. He/ She will later submit the result to the Chairman/Director for further process to the Controller of Examinations.

SUBMISSION OF FINAL TEST RESULT
Once the “Paper Review Day” is held the result of the Final Test will be displayed by the teacher on the notice board within fifteen days after the conduct of paper. The teacher will submit assessed scripts of Final Test after a period of two months.

DECLARATION OF THE RESULT BY CONTROLLER
All the HoDs will submit the result of final test to the Controller Examination with in eighteen days of the conduct of the paper. Subsequently the controller of examination will finalize and announce the final result within forty five days of the conduct of the last paper.

SEMESTER COMMITTEE
That if any Student applies for re-assessment his/her application will be entertained within 7 days of the announcement of the result by the Controller of Examinations with the payment of Rs. 500/- per subject. However, if his/her request is found genuine and marks are enhanced the fees will be refunded to the student. Semester Committee will be comprised of three most senior teachers of the department. The decision of Semester Committee will be final.

VICE CHANCELLOR’S AUTHORITY
The Vice Chancellor has powers to issue orders, and instructions where the regulations are silent and in cases of ambiguity or discrepancy regarding the interpretation of semester rules and regulations, the decision of Vice Chancellor shall be final.

INTRODUCTION
The Department of Sociology was established in 2006 with a vision to establish a Centre for teaching and research in Sociology. The main motive behind the setup of this department was to equip the new generation with the modern knowledge of Sociology and encourage debate and interrogation about the relationships between economic, political, social, spatial and cultural change.

The Department of Sociology aims to provide a conducive teaching and learning environment. We are committed to establish the discipline in the region of northern Sindh. We welcome the best graduate students from all over Pakistan. They join a community of several other students who are benefitted by the experiences of national and international graduates.

VISION
To empower the new generation through modern techniques of Sociology so that they can live amicably and peacefully.

Kamyab Jawan Talent Hunt Youth weightlifting

The national youth sports league will provide opportunities for youth to get involved in physical activities not only as a participant but as a professional player, coaches, leaders and volunteer. As part of ongoing activities, HEC hopes to develop these young people to become equipped with the knowledge, skills and attitudes needed to live together in peace and harmony and to empower them to discover their talent and make the most of their potential. The initiative will also help in revenue generation and robust sports and tourism.

DEPARTMENT OF STATISTICS

Mr. Abdul Qadeer Memon

INTRODUCTION
The Department of Statistics was established in 1976. Since then we are imparting best quality education in different courses of statistics. This department offers advanced courses in BS (Four Year) Program, M.Sc. Most recently we have introduced some new courses realizing the fact that the requirement of the statistical courses especially in various other fields is increasingly high. We have organized M.Phil & Ph.D. Programs in applied statistics.

Statistics is a rapidly evolving discipline with applications to wide variety of other scientific, management and engineering fields. In particular, modern computer technology facilitates the development of high-quality and computer-intensive statistical procedures and makes it possible to apply them to diverse statistical problems in the real world.

VISION
Our vision for the next five years is to strengthen our national and international reputation in collaborative scientific activity without compromising our core strength of excellence in statistical theory and methods.
